gwp_clan_description.en: The Grey Wardens began as an order within the Imperial priesthood, charged with patrol and punishment. After the Empire fractured, they broke from the rule of its lords but continued to bind themselves and others to Heaven's commandments. Women command the order, priests preach its faith, and village congregations supply recruits and provisions. They pursue raiders and protect villages and trade routes, regarding punishment as a religious duty. The common folk rely on their protection and fear the severity of their judgment.
gwp_clan_description.zh: 灰袍起初是帝国教会中承担巡察与惩戒的一支修会。帝国分裂后，她们脱离了诸侯的统辖，仍奉上天的诫命约束自身，也要求旁人守戒。修会由女性统领，教士在各地传教，村中的教众为她们提供兵员与供给。她们缉捕劫掠者，保护村庄与商路，并把惩戒罪行视为信仰的一部分。平民依靠她们的庇护，也畏惧她们严苛的审判。
gwp_clan_description.context: 家族百科总介绍；出身、政教分离与严苛惩戒为按用户方向拟写的模组设定，非原版事实。

gwp_clan_intro.en: We are the Grey Wardens, bound by Heaven's commandments to watch over these lands. The order answers to no lord. We pursue those who raid villages or attack travellers, whoever they serve.
gwp_clan_intro.zh: 我们是灰袍，奉上天的诫命巡察各地。修会不受诸侯差遣。有人劫掠村庄、袭击行旅，我们就会追捕，不论他为谁效命。

gwp_enc_chenxi.en: {HERO_NAME} oversees the rebuilding of villages after war. When the pursuit has moved on, she often remains to arrange repairs, clear wells, and help scattered families return. She regards this work as a duty of faith, as necessary as pursuing the raiders. She is warm and willing to share the work herself, and is good at putting a tangled situation in order one task at a time.
gwp_enc_chenxi.zh: {HERO_NAME}负责战后的村庄重建。追兵离开以后，她往往还留在村里，安排人手修屋、清井，帮助流散的人家回来。她把这些劳作视作应尽的侍奉，与追捕劫掠者同样要紧。她待人热心，愿意亲手分担活计，也擅长把纷乱的事情一件件安排妥当。
gwp_enc_chenxi.context: 创始领主晨曦的百科介绍，对应重建；修屋清井是重建的叙事描写，不新增工程功能。

gwp_enc_mise.en: {HERO_NAME} pursues those who attack villages. She remembers the names of many burned settlements and knows the paths their people take when fleeing. News of a raid sends her gathering riders; she holds that no one's faith can excuse their being robbed or killed. She rarely raises her voice and listens patiently to those who have suffered. Before a fight, she arranges shelter for the old and the young.
gwp_enc_mise.zh: {HERO_NAME}负责村庄遇袭后的追捕。她记得不少被烧毁的村名，也熟悉村民逃难时常走的小路。接到劫掠的消息，她便召集人手出发；在她看来，是否入教都不能成为任人劫杀的理由。她不善高声争辩，却愿意耐心听完受害者的话；开战前总先安排老幼避险。
gwp_enc_mise.context: 创始领主弥瑟的百科介绍；拟稿中的保护不限信仰来自“保护平民”方向，不增添信仰筛选机制。

gwp_enc_muguang.en: {HERO_NAME} receives appeals from nobles for the order, with particular concern for wrongs done to its members. She first hears what happened, then brings those concerned before a public decision. When precedent offers no answer, she takes the matter back to the order for discussion. She speaks gently and considers a promise before making it. Once committed, she patiently sees the matter through.
gwp_enc_muguang.zh: {HERO_NAME}替修会接待贵族的申诉，尤其留意灰袍成员遭受的不公。她会先问清事情的经过，再召集有关的人公开议决。旧例不能解决的事，她也愿意带回修会商议。她说话温和，许诺之前会想清楚；一旦答应，便会耐心把事情办到底。
gwp_enc_muguang.context: 创始领主暮光的百科介绍，对应贵族事务。

gwp_enc_shengduo.en: {HERO_NAME} hears petitions for the order. Village headmen, merchants, and artisans bring disputes before her, and she enters the alleys to question those unwilling to approach an official. She carries old Imperial statutes to help establish the facts, then mediates under the order's rule. She is quick-witted and often eases an argument with a joke, then asks careful questions when accounts disagree.
gwp_enc_shengduo.zh: {HERO_NAME}为修会听取各地请愿。村庄首领、商人和工匠都可能向她陈述争端，她也会走进巷道询问那些不愿见官的人。她随身带着旧帝国的法令，用它们辨明案情，再依修会的戒律主持调解。她头脑灵活，常用一句玩笑缓和争执，遇到证词矛盾时又问得很细。
gwp_enc_shengduo.context: 创始领主圣铎的百科介绍，对应要人请愿。

gwp_enc_vandi.en: {HERO_NAME} is the present Warden-General and oversees the training of the order's soldiers. Before dawn she often inspects recruits and has veterans close the gaps in their shield wall. She believes Heaven has charged the Wardens with protecting the common folk, and forbids them to use the order to pursue crowns or enlarge private estates. She speaks plainly and sets clear expectations. When danger comes, she expects to take the first risk herself.
gwp_enc_vandi.zh: {HERO_NAME}是灰袍现任统领，负责训练修会的战士。她常在天亮前检阅新兵，要求老兵亲自纠正盾墙的空隙。她相信守护百姓是上天交给灰袍的职责，不许部下以修会之名争夺王位或扩张私产。她说话简短，做事先立规矩；遇险时总要求自己先站到前面。
gwp_enc_vandi.context: 创始领主梵蒂的百科介绍，对应练兵本职。

gwp_enc_yoer.en: {HERO_NAME} protects the trade roads, riding between bridges, ferries, and markets. She pursues attacks on caravans and unlawful tolls, refusing to dismiss them as ordinary wartime losses. Many who trade along these roads know her grey mantle. She is cheerful and enjoys talking with her escorts on the march. Once she has promised to keep a road safe, she is slow to abandon it.
gwp_enc_yoer.zh: {HERO_NAME}负责保护商路，常在桥梁、渡口和集市之间奔走。她追查商队遇袭与沿途勒索，不肯把这些事当作战争中无须过问的小事。走这几条路的商人，许多都认得她的灰袍。她性子爽朗，行军时也愿陪护卫谈笑，答应替人守住的路便不肯轻易放弃。
gwp_enc_yoer.context: 创始领主约珥的百科介绍，对应商队护卫。

gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.en: I accept. I shall serve the Grey Wardens in this matter.
gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.zh: 我接受，愿为灰袍守卫效力。

gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.en: Then take this harness. Wear it when you ride under our warrant, and bring the money or prisoner to a Warden-lord.
gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.zh: 那就收下这套甲胄，穿着它替我们办案。收来的罚金或捉到的罪犯，交给灰袍领主。

gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.en: If the pursuit brings war upon you, we will speak for you when the matter is settled.
gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.zh: 若因此惹上战事，交差后我们会出面调停。
不，我不感兴趣。

gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.en: As you will. This herald will not trouble you again; if you later reconsider, speak to a Warden-lord.
gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.zh: 随你。这名使者不会再来打扰；以后若改变主意，可以亲自找一位灰袍领主谈。

gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.en: Our business is concluded. Go on your way.
gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.zh: 我们的事务已了结，请继续前行。
关于那个悬赏任务，我已击败目标，来结算赏金。
关于那个悬赏任务，我已经完成了。

gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.en: The Grey Wardens have heard of your deeds. Will you hunt outlaws for us? There is pay for the work.
gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.zh: 灰袍听说了你的事迹。愿不愿意替我们追捕罪犯？办妥了，自有酬劳。

gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.en: You are now a Grey Warden bounty hunter. The black commander's gear is in your baggage; wear it, and the Wardens will entrust bounties to you.
gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.zh: 你已成为灰袍悬赏猎人。黑袍指挥官套装已放入你的行囊，穿上它，灰袍便会向你托付悬赏。

gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.en: You decline the Wardens. You may still ask a Warden lord to join them later.
gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.zh: 你回绝了灰袍的招募。日后可以向灰袍领主请求加入。

gwp_membership_rejoin_player.en: I wish to petition for a place among the Grey Warden sworn hunters again.
gwp_membership_rejoin_player.zh: 我想再次申请成为灰袍受托猎手。

gwp_membership_rejoin_response.en: Your petition is accepted. You are again recognised as a sworn hunter; take a fresh commander's harness and answer our warrants faithfully.
gwp_membership_rejoin_response.zh: 你的申请获得批准。你重新成为灰袍受托猎手；收下这套新的指挥官装备，认真履行我们交付的通缉任务。

gwp_membership_leave_player.en: I wish to relinquish my place with the Grey Wardens.
gwp_membership_leave_player.zh: 我想退出灰袍，不再担任受托猎手。

gwp_membership_leave_prompt_higher.en: If you withdraw, your warrants, detachments, and battlefield relief end. Readmission will require {VAR_1} standing and a personal appeal to a Warden-lord. Is this your final decision?
gwp_membership_leave_prompt_higher.zh: 退出后，你将失去通缉任务、兵员征调与战场支援。再次加入需要达到 {VAR_1} 声望，并亲自向灰袍领主申请。你确定这是最后决定吗？

gwp_membership_leave_prompt_final.en: If you withdraw this time, your name will be struck permanently and no Warden-lord will readmit you. Is this your final decision?
gwp_membership_leave_prompt_final.zh: 这次退出后，你的名字将被永久从名册上划去，任何灰袍领主都不会再接纳你。你确定这是最后决定吗？

gwp_membership_leave_confirm.en: Yes. Remove my name from the roll.
gwp_membership_leave_confirm.zh: 确定。把我的名字从名册上划掉吧。

gwp_membership_leave_done.en: It is done. The equipment already entrusted to you remains yours, but it no longer grants any Grey Warden authority.
gwp_membership_leave_done.zh: 已经办妥。此前交给你的装备仍归你所有，但它不再代表任何灰袍权限。

gwp_membership_leave_cancelled.en: Then your place on the roll remains unchanged.
gwp_membership_leave_cancelled.zh: 那么你在名册上的位置维持不变。

gwp_bounty_membership_ended.en: You left the Grey Wardens, and the active bounty contract was withdrawn.
gwp_bounty_membership_ended.zh: 你已经退出灰袍，正在执行的悬赏契约随之撤销。

gwp_playerbountybehavior_dialogueandnoti.zh: 出色的工作。任务已完成，这是约定的赏金：{VAR_1} 第纳尔。
出色的工作。按照约定，这是你应得的赏金：{VAR_1} 第纳尔。希望我们还有合作的机会。
已从警察领主处领取悬赏赏金：{VAR_1} 第纳尔

gwp_dispatch_troop_order.en: Carry my order for troops to the Wardens, and the coin with it.
gwp_dispatch_troop_order.zh: 把我的练兵订单和订金一起送到灰袍手里。

gwp_player_troop_order_unaffordable.en: You cannot pay the deposit. The order was not placed.
gwp_player_troop_order_unaffordable.zh: 你付不起订金，订单未成立。

gwp_player_troop_order_short.en: What you offered falls short of the price. The order was not placed.
gwp_player_troop_order_short.zh: 所付钱物不足订价，订单未成立。

gwp_fa_charge_cooled.en: Let us take up that charge again.
gwp_fa_charge_cooled.zh: 这桩案子，我们再谈一次。

gwp_warden_mediation_owed.en: This war began when you fought for the Wardens. You may ask them to mediate.
gwp_warden_mediation_owed.zh: 此战因替灰袍出手而起，可请灰袍出面调停。

gwp_warden_marry_yes.en: Then it is settled. I am yours, and you are mine.
gwp_warden_marry_yes.zh: 那就这么定了。我是你的，你也是我的。

gwp_warden_mediation_ask.en: The fighting I did on your account has left me at war. Speak for me.
gwp_warden_mediation_ask.zh: 我替你们打的那些仗，把我卷进战争里了。出面替我说句话。

gwp_warden_mediation_done.en: Consider it carried. Word goes out today, and the quarrels you took up for us are closed.
gwp_warden_mediation_done.zh: 这事交给我们。今天就把话递出去，你替我们挑起来的那几桩，都了了。

gwp_warden_mediation_moot.en: There is nothing left for us to carry. Whatever you took up on our account is already settled.
gwp_warden_mediation_moot.zh: 没有什么要我们去递的了。你替我们担下的那些，早就平了。

gwp_dispatch_peace.en: Ride to the Wardens and have them close the quarrels I took up for them.
gwp_dispatch_peace.zh: 去灰袍那儿走一趟，把我替他们挑起来的那几桩梁子了了。

gwp_dispatch_peace_done.en: The message was delivered. The Wardens have made peace on your behalf.
gwp_dispatch_peace_done.zh: 信已送到，灰袍已代你与对方议和。

gwp_dispatch_peace_moot.en: The message was delivered, but there is nothing left to mediate.
gwp_dispatch_peace_moot.zh: 信已送到，但已无需调停。

gwp_fa_rebuff_upright.en: You have my answer. I do not give a man two.
gwp_fa_rebuff_upright.zh: 我的答复已经给过你了。一句话，我不说两遍。

gwp_fa_rebuff_cold.en: Nothing has changed since we last spoke.
gwp_fa_rebuff_cold.zh: 上回谈完到现在，什么都没变。

gwp_fa_rebuff_fierce.en: We settled this once already. Press me again and it will not be with words.
gwp_fa_rebuff_fierce.zh: 这事已经了断过一回。再逼我，就不是动嘴了。

gwp_fa_rebuff_soft.en: Please. We have been over it once already. Let it rest.
gwp_fa_rebuff_soft.zh: 行行好，这事已经翻过一遍了，让它歇歇吧。

gwp_fa_rebuff_tight.en: You have had your talk out of me. Talk is not free, and you have spent it.
gwp_fa_rebuff_tight.zh: 你已经从我这儿讨过话了。话也是要本钱的，你花完了。

gwp_fa_rebuff_plain.en: We have spoken about this. My answer stands.
gwp_fa_rebuff_plain.zh: 这事我们谈过了。我的答复不变。

gwp_dispatch_order_moot.en: The Wardens cannot take the order now. Your deposit is being returned.
gwp_dispatch_order_moot.zh: 灰袍眼下无法接单，订金将退回给你。

gwp_player_troop_order_filed_prepaid.en: Your order and deposit are with the Wardens. The Training Warden will bring the soldiers to you herself.
gwp_player_troop_order_filed_prepaid.zh: 订单与订金已交给灰袍，练兵领主训练完成后会亲自送来。

gwp_bounty_contract_turnin.en: Break his army, collect the fine, or take him prisoner, then report to any Grey Warden lord. Bring him in alive and the Wardens also buy him from you at his ransom price.
gwp_bounty_contract_turnin.zh: 击溃其部队、收取罚金或将其俘虏，之后向任意灰袍领主复命。若把人活着押来，灰袍另按赎金价向你收购。

gwp_troop_order_cohort_lost.en: The soldiers being trained for you were lost on the road. The Wardens are training another company.
gwp_troop_order_cohort_lost.zh: 为你训练的士兵在途中覆没，灰袍正重新训练一批。

gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.en: By Grey Warden ordinance, the lawful fine must first be paid.
gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.zh: 按灰袍法令，先把正式罚金缴清。

gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.en: The fine is acknowledged. This case is closed; you may depart.
gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.zh: 罚金确认。本轮案件结案，你可以离开了。

gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.en: Your offer falls below the lawful fine. You may raise it or choose another response.
gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.zh: 你的出价低于正式罚金。你可以继续出价，或选择其他处理方式。

gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.en: I confess the offence and accept judgment. Grant me a charge of atonement.
gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.zh: 我认罪认罚，请给我赎罪任务。

gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.en: No charge of atonement can presently be assigned. You may pay the fine or refuse the order.
gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.zh: 当前无法分配赎罪任务。你可以继续缴纳罚金，或拒绝执法。

gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.en: I refuse the order. Let arms decide.
gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.zh: 拒绝执法，开战。

gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.en: Resistance is entered upon the roll. Grey Wardens—make the arrest!
gwp_policeenforcementbehavior_dialogue_0.zh: 拒捕记录在案。灰袍守卫，执行抓捕！

gwp_troop_req_high.zh: 你在灰袍这里的名声已经够高。我可以调出弓手或披甲骑巡，但只能从我自己当前带领的部队中调。

gwp_troop_req_low.zh: 你现在的名声只够调灰袍新兵，而且我只能把自己部队里现有的人交给你。

gwp_troop_req_mid.zh: 你已证明自己值得托付。灰袍新兵之外，只要我自己的部队中数量足够，也可以调出重装步兵或执勤弓手。

gwp_sparring_challenge.en: Would you like to spar with me? I want to test my skill.
gwp_sparring_challenge.zh: 愿意和我切磋一下吗？我想试试自己的水平。

gwp_sparring_accept.en: Of course. Just a friendly match.
gwp_sparring_accept.zh: 当然。只是友好切磋，不伤和气。

gwp_sparring_launch_failed.zh: 这里不适合切磋，这次就先算了。

gwp_sparring_field_rule_loss.en: You did not dismount in time. You lose.
gwp_sparring_field_rule_loss.zh: 你没有按时下马，这场算你输。

gwp_sparring_field_centre.en: How do you want to fight?

gwp_sparring_field_post_win.en: You fought well and earned that win. Keep it up.
gwp_sparring_field_post_win.zh: 打得很好，你赢得很漂亮。继续保持。

gwp_sparring_field_post_loss.en: Don't be discouraged. You fought well, and you'll be stronger next time.
gwp_sparring_field_post_loss.zh: 别灰心，你打得不错。下次再来，我相信你会更强。

gwp_sparring_field_post_rule_violation.en: We agreed to fight on foot, but you refused to dismount. The loss is yours.
gwp_sparring_field_post_rule_violation.zh: 说好步战，你却一直不肯下马。这场算你输。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_calcul.en: Whatever gain you imagine in a burning village, set it against years of pursuit before you decide.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_calcul.zh: 无论你以为烧毁村庄能得到多少，都先把此后多年的追捕算进去。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_cruel.en: Burn what you like, but understand that the Grey Wardens know how to make memory outlive pride.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_cruel.zh: 你想烧什么都随你，但要明白，灰袍有办法让记忆活得比傲慢更久。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_honora.en: I tell you plainly: protect the villages under your power, or justice will eventually find you as well.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_honora.zh: 我明白地告诫你：保护你权力之下的村庄，否则公正迟早也会找到你。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_mercif.en: Spare yourself this lesson by sparing the people who would otherwise suffer first.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_mercif.zh: 先放过那些最早受苦的人，你也就不必亲自承受这份教训。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_neutra.en: Stay away from that path unless you are prepared for the Grey Wardens to follow it back to you.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_neutra.zh: 除非你已经准备好让灰袍沿着这条路一直追到你面前，否则就离它远一点。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_valoro.en: If you want a worthy enemy, seek one who can fight back; the Grey Wardens will answer if you choose the helpless.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_valoro.zh: 如果你想找一个配得上的敌人，就找能够还手的人；若你选择弱者，灰袍自会回应。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_calcula.en: If profit is what guides you, remember to include the Grey Wardens in your reckoning.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_calcula.zh: 如果你只看重收益，记得把灰袍也算进你的账里。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_cruel.en: Do as you please, but do not say no one warned you what follows.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_cruel.zh: 你尽可以照自己的意思做，只是别说从来没人提醒过你后果。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_honorab.en: Take it as honest advice: do not bring the same judgment on yourself by preying on villages.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_honorab.zh: 这是一句诚实的劝告：不要靠伤害村庄，让同样的裁断落到自己头上。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_mercifu.en: You can choose a better road before frightened families are made to pay for it.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_mercifu.zh: 趁那些惊恐的家庭还没有为你付出代价，你仍然可以选择一条更好的路。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_neutral.en: You would be wise to remember that before choosing your own targets.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_neutral.zh: 在选择自己的目标以前，你最好记住这一点。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_valorou.en: Test your courage on armed warriors, not on villagers who cannot answer you.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_valorou.zh: 真想证明勇气，就去面对持有武器的战士，而不是无法反抗的村民。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_calc.en: If you intend to raid, understand that the cost may follow you long after the loot is spent.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_calc.zh: 如果你准备劫掠，就要明白：赃物花光以后，那份代价可能仍会追着你。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_crue.en: Choose that road if you wish. Just be ready to pay more than you take.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_crue.zh: 你愿意走那条路就去吧，只要准备好付出的比抢到的更多。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_hono.en: Keep faith with the innocent, and you will never need to learn that lesson as I did.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_hono.zh: 守住对无辜者的本分，你就不必像我一样亲自学会这个道理。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_merc.en: Leave the villages in peace; their people have already endured enough from lords like us.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_merc.zh: 让村庄安宁一些吧。那里的百姓已经受够了我们这些领主带来的苦难。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_neut.en: Consider the consequence before you make the same choice.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_neut.zh: 在作出同样的选择之前，先想清楚后果。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_valo.en: Do not mistake cruelty toward the helpless for bravery, nor the Grey Wardens' patience for weakness.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_valo.zh: 不要把欺凌弱者当作勇敢，也不要把灰袍的耐心当作软弱。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_calculat.en: Because you work with them, you should understand this: fear spends quickly, but consistent law keeps paying.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_calculat.zh: 既然你与他们共事，就该明白：恐惧很快就会耗尽，始终如一的规矩才能维持得更久。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_cruel.en: Their mark is on my house, and you have chosen their side. Do not expect me to confuse either with friendship.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_cruel.zh: 他们的印记留在我的家族身上，而你选择了站在他们一边。别指望我会把其中任何一样当成友谊。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_honorabl.en: You represent them now. If their justice is to mean anything, your conduct must be cleaner than the crimes you pursue.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_honorabl.zh: 你现在代表着他们。若他们的公正真有意义，你的行为就必须比自己追捕的罪行更加干净。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_merciful.en: Stand between the Grey Wardens and needless suffering when you can; justice has no need to become cruelty.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_merciful.zh: 在你做得到的时候，挡住灰袍与不必要的痛苦；公正没有必要变成残忍。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_neutral.en: You chose to work with the Grey Wardens. Then you should know that what they do is remembered long after the warrant closes.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_neutral.zh: 你选择与灰袍共事，就应该知道：通缉令了结以后，他们做过的事仍会被人记很久。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_valorous.en: Stand with them boldly if you must, but let your courage be measured by whom you protect, not whom you can frighten.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_valorous.zh: 要和他们站在一起，就堂堂正正地站；但衡量勇气的应是你保护了谁，而不是你能吓倒谁。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_calculati.en: You chose to work with the Grey Wardens; that makes candour more useful than pretence.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_calculati.zh: 你既然选择替灰袍办事，与其彼此装糊涂，不如把话说明白。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_cruel.en: So you chose to work with them. Do not expect that alone to make every lord bow.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_cruel.zh: 原来你选择了替他们办事。别以为仅凭这一点，所有领主都会低头。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_honorable.en: Since you serve beside them, hold yourself to the same law they claimed to uphold when they intervened.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_honorable.zh: 既然你为他们效力，就应当遵守他们出手干预时所宣称维护的同一套规矩。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_merciful.en: If you work with them, use that place to protect villagers before punishment becomes necessary.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_merciful.zh: 如果你与他们共事，就利用自己的位置保护村民，别等到只能事后惩罚。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_neutral.en: You serve with the Grey Wardens, so you should understand why the matter is remembered.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_neutral.zh: 你在替灰袍做事，应该明白为什么这件事会被人记住。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_valorous.en: You carry their authority now; prove that it rests on courage rather than intimidation.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_valorous.zh: 你现在也带着他们的权威；证明这份权威依靠的是勇气，而不是恫吓。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_calcul.en: A Grey Warden ally should know that measured enforcement wins more obedience than needless humiliation.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_calcul.zh: 与灰袍合作的人应该明白：有分寸的执法，比无谓的羞辱更容易换来长久的服从。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_cruel.en: You may hunt for them, but do not mistake a warrant for invincibility.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_cruel.zh: 你可以替他们追捕别人，但别把一纸通缉令误当成刀枪不入。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_honora.en: If you act in their name, keep the law above vengeance, even when the accused deserves no sympathy.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_honora.zh: 如果你以他们的名义行事，就该让规矩高于报复，即便被指控的人并不值得同情。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_mercif.en: Use your place among them to prevent the next village from suffering, not merely to punish afterward.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_mercif.zh: 利用你在他们之中的位置，阻止下一个村庄受害，而不是只在事后惩罚罪人。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_neutra.en: You know their methods from the other side of the warrant; remember what those methods leave behind.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_neutra.zh: 你如今站在通缉令的另一边，应该记得这些手段最终会在人身上留下什么。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_valoro.en: If you bear their authority, meet armed offenders openly and leave terror to lesser people.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_valoro.zh: 既然承担他们的权威，就该堂堂正正面对持械的犯人，把恐吓留给更卑劣的人。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_calculating.en: No one in my clan now discusses a village raid without first accounting for the Grey Wardens' answer.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_calculating.zh: 现在，家族里没有人会在谈论劫掠村庄时，不先计算灰袍将会作出的回应。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_cruel.en: Their hand still lies heavy on my clan. We have not submitted; we have merely learned when vengeance is too costly.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_cruel.zh: 他们的手至今仍沉重地压在我的家族身上。我们没有屈服，只是学会了何时报复的代价太高。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_honorable.en: The lesson reached the whole clan: rank and blood do not excuse a crime against those under our protection.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_honorable.zh: 整个家族都已经明白：身份和血统不能成为伤害受我们保护之人的借口。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_merciful.en: If my kin finally understand the suffering they caused, then perhaps something decent can still come from the punishment.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_merciful.zh: 如果我的族人终于明白自己造成了多少痛苦，那么这场惩罚至少还能留下些善果。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_neutral.en: The consequences settled over the entire clan. None of us now treats the Grey Wardens as a distant concern.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_neutral.zh: 那场后果笼罩了整个家族。如今没有人还会把灰袍当成与自己无关的遥远传闻。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_valorous.en: My house still has courage, but courage now walks beside a very clear memory of the Grey Wardens.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_valorous.zh: 我的家族仍有勇气，只是这份勇气如今总会与对灰袍的清晰记忆同行。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_calculating.en: What happened to my kin gave the clan a useful measure of the risks involved.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_calculating.zh: 发生在族人身上的事，让家族对其中的风险有了一个有用的估量。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_cruel.en: They laid hands on my blood. I remember it, even while I let the matter rest.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_cruel.zh: 他们动了我的血亲。即便我暂时不再追究，也不会忘记。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_honorable.en: My kin crossed a boundary. I cannot call the Grey Wardens wrong for answering it.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_honorable.zh: 我的族人的确越过了界。我不能说灰袍出手回应是错的。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_merciful.en: I am more troubled by the villagers who suffered than by my kin's wounded pride.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_merciful.zh: 比起族人受伤的颜面，我更在意那些遭受伤害的村民。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_neutral.en: The affair touched my family, so naturally the clan remembers it.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_neutral.zh: 那件事牵连了我的家人，家族自然会记得。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_valorous.en: My clan took a blow; it did not lose its courage. Still, the warning was clear.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_valorous.zh: 我的家族受过打击，却没有失去勇气。不过，那次警告已经足够清楚。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_calculatin.en: The clan has counted the men, coin, and freedom that one reckless choice cost us.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_calculatin.zh: 一个鲁莽的选择让我们损失了多少士兵、钱财和自由，家族已经全部算清了。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_cruel.en: The Grey Wardens made my clan bleed for another's mistake. Such accounts are not forgotten.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_cruel.zh: 灰袍让我的家族为别人的错误流了血。这种账不会被轻易忘记。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_honorable.en: My kinsman broke the peace and the clan paid for it. Responsibility does not vanish merely because blood is shared.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_honorable.zh: 我的族人破坏了安宁，家族也为此付出了代价。血缘并不会让责任凭空消失。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_merciful.en: I would rather my family learn restraint than leave more peasants grieving for what nobles chose to do.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_merciful.zh: 我宁愿家人学会克制，也不愿再让农民为贵族的选择失去亲人。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_neutral.en: What happened to one of us changed how the whole clan speaks of raids and reprisals.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_neutral.zh: 发生在一个族人身上的事，已经改变了整个家族谈论劫掠与报复的方式。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_valorous.en: We are not cowed, but neither will we charge blindly into the same punishment twice.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_valorous.zh: 我们并没有被吓倒，但也不会再盲目冲进同一种惩罚之中。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_calculatin.en: Now every road toward a village includes the same figure in my reckoning: what the Grey Wardens will take in return.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_calculatin.zh: 现在，每一条通往村庄的路都要算上同一笔账：灰袍会从我这里取走什么作为代价。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_cruel.en: I remember exactly what they did. My restraint is calculation, not surrender and certainly not forgiveness.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_cruel.zh: 他们做过什么，我记得一清二楚。我的克制只是算计，不是屈服，更不是原谅。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_honorable.en: I was guilty, and the punishment was deserved. The depth of the lesson does not make the judgment less just.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_honorable.zh: 我确实有罪，所受的惩罚也并不过分。教训再深，也不会让那次裁断变得不公。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_merciful.en: What weighs on me most is not what they did to me, but what my choices had already done to people who could not resist.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_merciful.zh: 真正压在我心上的，不是他们对我做了什么，而是我的选择早已伤害了那些无力反抗的人。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_neutral.en: Their intervention changed how I judge every raid, every captive, and every road back home.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_neutral.zh: 那次处置改变了我看待每次劫掠、每个俘虏，以及每一条归路的方式。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_valorous.en: I could face them again. That does not mean I am foolish enough to call them harmless.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_valorous.zh: 我仍然敢再面对他们，但这不代表我会愚蠢到把他们当成无害之人。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_calculating.en: That affair taught me where the cost begins to outweigh the gain.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_calculating.zh: 那件事让我明白，什么时候代价会开始超过收益。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_cruel.en: They made their point. I have simply chosen not to test it again yet.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_cruel.zh: 他们已经表明了态度。我只不过暂时不打算再试一次。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_honorable.en: I crossed a boundary, and being stopped was the proper consequence.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_honorable.zh: 我确实越过了界，被人阻止也是应有的结果。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_merciful.en: Whatever my reasons, villagers should not have borne the price.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_merciful.zh: 不管我当时有什么理由，都不该让村民承担代价。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_neutral.en: The matter is over, but I have not discarded its lesson.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_neutral.zh: 那件事已经过去，但我并没有丢掉它留下的教训。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_valorous.en: One defeat does not make me afraid, but it taught me to respect the Grey Wardens' reach.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_valorous.zh: 一次失败不会让我害怕，但它让我知道不能轻视灰袍的能耐。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_calculat.en: I have measured the losses twice. No village is worth drawing that pursuit without a far greater purpose.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_calculat.zh: 损失我已经算过两遍。若没有更大的目的，没有哪个村庄值得招来那样的追捕。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_cruel.en: They hurt me enough to make patience useful. Do not confuse that with remorse.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_cruel.zh: 他们下手够重，让耐心变得有用。可别把这当成悔意。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_honorabl.en: I broke the peace and answered for it. Denying that would only add cowardice to the fault.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_honorabl.zh: 我破坏了安宁，也为此承担了后果。否认这一点，只会在过错之外再添一分怯懦。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_merciful.en: I remember the frightened villagers more clearly than the chains. That is reason enough to stop.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_merciful.zh: 相比锁链，我记得更清楚的是那些受惊的村民。仅凭这一点，也足够让我停手。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_neutral.en: Since that capture, every raid carries a second calculation: whether the Grey Wardens will answer.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_neutral.zh: 自从那次被捕以后，每次劫掠都多了一层盘算：灰袍会不会赶来。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_valorous.en: I do not fear a hard fight, but only a fool mistakes courage for blindness to consequence.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_valorous.zh: 我不怕艰难的战斗，但只有蠢人才会把勇气当成不计后果。

gwp_ai_det_intro_family_high.en: {HERO_NAME}'s expression hardens for a moment. The Grey Wardens' actions still hang heavily over their clan.
gwp_ai_det_intro_family_high.zh: {HERO_NAME}的神色一度变得冷硬。灰袍的行动所造成的后果，至今仍沉重地压在其家族身上。

gwp_ai_det_intro_family_low.en: {HERO_NAME} pauses briefly before speaking. The Grey Wardens' dealings with their kin have not quite been forgotten.
gwp_ai_det_intro_family_low.zh: {HERO_NAME}开口前短暂停顿了一下。灰袍与其族人之间发生的事，显然还没有被完全忘记。

gwp_ai_det_intro_family_medium.en: {HERO_NAME} chooses each word carefully. Their clan's encounter with the Grey Wardens remains a serious concern.
gwp_ai_det_intro_family_medium.zh: {HERO_NAME}谨慎地选择着措辞。家族与灰袍的那次冲突，至今仍是一件不能轻视的事。

gwp_ai_det_intro_personal_high.en: {HERO_NAME} holds your gaze with deliberate composure. What the Grey Wardens did to them left a mark too deep to conceal.
gwp_ai_det_intro_personal_high.zh: {HERO_NAME}刻意保持镇定，直视着你。灰袍曾在其身上留下的影响，已经深得难以掩饰。

gwp_ai_det_intro_personal_low.en: {HERO_NAME} regards you steadily. Their encounter with the Grey Wardens is remembered, but it does not rule their manner.
gwp_ai_det_intro_personal_low.zh: {HERO_NAME}平静地看着你。与灰袍的那次交锋仍被其记在心里，却还没有左右其举止。

gwp_ai_det_intro_personal_medium.en: {HERO_NAME}'s voice grows more measured. Their own encounter with the Grey Wardens still weighs on every word.
gwp_ai_det_intro_personal_medium.zh: {HERO_NAME}的语气变得更加慎重。亲自面对灰袍的经历，至今仍影响着其说出的每一句话。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_cautio.en: If self-preservation matters to you, do not give them a reason to learn your name.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_cautio.zh: 如果你还在乎保全自己，就不要给他们记住你名字的理由。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_closef.en: Even the most selfish arithmetic reaches the same answer: a raid is not worth what they collect afterward.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_closef.zh: 即便按照最自私的算法，答案也一样：一次劫掠不值得灰袍事后收取的代价。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_dishon.en: Choose carefully which laws you break. The Grey Wardens care more about the deed than the excuse.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_dishon.zh: 仔细选择你要破坏哪些规矩。灰袍更在意你做了什么，而不是你准备了什么借口。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_genero.en: Think of your clan and followers before you make them inherit the price of your decision.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_genero.zh: 在让家族和追随者继承你决定的代价以前，先替他们想一想。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_impuls.en: If your temper commands you, the Grey Wardens may be the ones who decide when it stops.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_high_impuls.zh: 如果让脾气指挥你，最后可能由灰袍决定它何时停止。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_cautiou.en: You need not prove anything by provoking people who will pursue you without tiring.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_cautiou.zh: 你没有必要通过招惹一群会不知疲倦地追捕你的人来证明什么。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_closefi.en: If conscience does not move you, then protect your own purse and soldiers.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_closefi.zh: 如果良心不能打动你，那就至少保护好自己的钱袋和士兵。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_dishono.en: Keep your promises if it suits you, but at least do not make yourself such easy prey.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_dishono.zh: 守不守承诺由你，但至少不要让自己成为如此容易对付的猎物。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_generou.en: Do not make your followers and family pay for a choice made only to satisfy you.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_generou.zh: 不要让追随者和家人为一个只用来满足你自己的选择付出代价。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_impulsi.en: Do not let one angry moment choose a road that takes years to escape.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_low_impulsi.zh: 不要让一时的怒火替你选择一条需要多年才能逃离的道路。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_caut.en: Turn away from the villages while the choice is still yours; retreat is cheaper before pursuit begins.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_caut.zh: 趁选择权还在自己手里，离那些村庄远一点。追捕开始以前退让，代价要小得多。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_clos.en: The loot from a village will not repay the men, coin, and freedom that pursuit can cost.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_clos.zh: 一个村庄的战利品，补不回追捕可能夺走的士兵、钱财和自由。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_dish.en: If you cross that line, do not imagine that rank or a convenient excuse will shield you.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_dish.zh: 如果你越过那条界线，别以为身份或一个方便的借口能够保护你。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_gene.en: A lord owes protection to those who trust them, not a trail of losses created for pride.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_gene.zh: 领主欠信任自己的人一份保护，而不是为了骄傲留下一路损失。

gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_impu.en: Pause before you order the torches lit. Anger leaves faster than consequences.
gwp_ai_det_audience_outsider_medium_impu.zh: 下令点燃火把以前先停一下。怒火消失的速度，总比后果更快。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_cautious.en: If the Grey Wardens send you after dangerous people, remember that caution keeps an enforcer alive.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_cautious.zh: 如果灰袍派你追捕危险的人，记住，谨慎才能让执法者活下来。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_closefis.en: If you serve only for profit, understand that uncontrolled enforcement eventually costs more than it pays.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_closefis.zh: 如果你只为收益而效力，就要明白：不受约束的执法，最终造成的损失会超过报酬。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_dishonor.en: If you call what you do justice, prove it through consistent conduct rather than the power to punish.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_dishonor.zh: 如果你把自己的行为称为公正，就用始终如一的行为来证明，而不是依靠惩罚别人的权力。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_generous.en: Their authority makes you responsible for everyone placed in danger by your decisions.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_generous.zh: 他们给你的权威，也让你必须为所有因你的决定而陷入危险的人负责。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_impulsiv.en: If temper governs your sword, their authority will not stop you from becoming another danger to the innocent.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_high_impulsiv.zh: 如果脾气支配了你的剑，他们的权威也无法阻止你变成无辜者面对的另一种危险。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_cautious.en: Authority can make a fool reckless. Do not let their name push you into a fight you have not measured.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_cautious.zh: 权威会让蠢人变得鲁莽。别让他们的名号把你推入一场尚未衡量过的战斗。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_closefist.en: If a bounty pays you, do not pretend that coin and justice are the same thing.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_closefist.zh: 如果悬赏会给你钱，就不要假装钱财与公正是同一回事。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_dishonora.en: You carry their warrants, but ink alone does not turn power into virtue.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_dishonora.zh: 你替他们拿着通缉令，但纸上的墨迹并不能自动把权力变成美德。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_generous.en: If you serve them, remember the people who follow you and will pay for every order.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_generous.zh: 既然为他们效力，就记住那些追随你、并会为你的每一道命令付出代价的人。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_impulsive.en: A warrant does not excuse acting in anger. You are still answerable for what follows.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_low_impulsive.zh: 通缉令不能为愤怒中的行动开脱。接下来发生的事，仍然要由你负责。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_cautio.en: A warrant is no substitute for knowing when to advance and when to withdraw.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_cautio.zh: 一纸通缉令，代替不了判断何时前进、何时退让的能力。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_closef.en: Do not spend other people's lives merely to enlarge your reward.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_closef.zh: 不要仅仅为了增加自己的赏金，就拿别人的性命作为花费。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_dishon.en: Use their authority if you must, but do not preach purity while bending the law for yourself.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_dishon.zh: 你可以使用他们的权威，但不要一边为自己歪曲规矩，一边向别人宣扬纯洁。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_genero.en: Protect your companions and the villagers alike; authority is a debt before it is a privilege.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_genero.zh: 保护好你的同伴，也保护好村民。权威在成为特权以前，首先是一份债务。

gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_impuls.en: Do not let an insult turn enforcement into vengeance simply because their seal is behind you.
gwp_ai_det_audience_warden_medium_impuls.zh: 不要因为身后有他们的印记，就让一次冒犯把执法变成报复。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_cautious.en: We know how completely they can close around a clan. Avoiding that danger again is survival, not submission.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_cautious.zh: 我们知道他们能够怎样彻底包围一个家族。避免再次陷入那种危险，是为了生存，不是屈服。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_closefisted.en: The Grey Wardens taught us that one relative's folly can become everyone's expense. I will not permit that twice.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_closefisted.zh: 灰袍让我们明白，一个亲族的愚行可能变成所有人的损失。我不会允许这种事发生第二次。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_dishonorable.en: My clan remembers the punishment as an insult, not a judgment. Restraint does not mean that we accept their right.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_dishonorable.zh: 我的家族把那场惩罚视为羞辱，而不是裁断。我们有所克制，并不代表承认他们拥有这种权力。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_generous.en: The whole clan carried the burden. I owe protection to those who kept faith when another brought ruin home.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_generous.zh: 整个家族都承担了那份重担。当有人把灾祸带回家时，我有责任保护那些仍然忠于家族的人。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_impulsive.en: The whole clan felt the consequence of one unchecked impulse. Now even anger must answer to that memory.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_high_impulsive.zh: 整个家族都承受了一个失控冲动造成的后果。如今就连愤怒，也必须先面对这段记忆。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_cautious.en: What happened to my kin showed us a danger the clan would be foolish to provoke without need.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_cautious.zh: 发生在族人身上的事让我们看清了一种危险。若无必要，家族主动招惹它才是愚蠢。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_closefisted.en: My kinsman's folly became a bill for the whole clan. They should have borne it alone.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_closefisted.zh: 族人的愚行变成了整个家族的账单。那原本应该由他自己承担。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_dishonorable.en: Blood comes before strangers' rules. I judge the Grey Wardens by what they did to my kin, not by the charge they named.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_dishonorable.zh: 血亲比外人的规矩更重要。我评判灰袍，只看他们对我的族人做了什么，而不是他们给出的罪名。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_generous.en: Whatever my kinsman's fault, they are still ours. We must correct them without abandoning them.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_generous.zh: 无论族人犯了什么错，他仍是我们的人。我们必须纠正他，却不能抛弃他。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_impulsive.en: My kin acted before thinking, and the rest of us were left to remember the result.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_low_impulsive.zh: 我的族人还没有想清楚就采取了行动，结果却留给我们所有人铭记。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_cautious.en: The clan has no desire to walk into the same trap merely to prove that it is unafraid.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_cautious.zh: 家族没有兴趣仅仅为了证明自己不怕，就再次走进同一个陷阱。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_closefiste.en: I have no intention of paying again for a relative's appetite for plunder.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_closefiste.zh: 我不打算再为某个亲族对劫掠的贪欲付账。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_dishonorab.en: Whatever my kinsman did, outsiders had no right to humble our house and call the matter justice.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_dishonorab.zh: 无论我的族人做过什么，外人都没有权力羞辱我们的家族，再把这称为公正。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_generous.en: One kinsman's mistake cost everyone who stood beside them. Our duty now is to repair what it damaged.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_generous.zh: 一个族人的错误让所有站在他身边的人付出了代价。我们现在的责任，是修补它造成的损害。

gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_impulsive.en: One hotheaded decision brought the Grey Wardens down on all of us. That is not easily forgotten.
gwp_ai_det_core_family_medium_impulsive.zh: 一个头脑发热的决定把灰袍引到了我们所有人面前。这种事情不会轻易被忘记。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_cautious.en: I survived by learning which fights to avoid. Giving them another reason to pursue me would be needless folly.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_cautious.zh: 我靠着学会避开某些战斗才活了下来。再给他们一个追捕我的理由，只是毫无必要的愚蠢。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_closefiste.en: I will not impoverish myself for plunder that the Grey Wardens can take back with interest.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_closefiste.zh: 我不会为了终将被灰袍连本带利夺回的战利品，把自己耗得一无所有。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_dishonorab.en: I regret being caught, not crossing their line. What changed is that I now hide my steps more carefully.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_dishonorab.zh: 我后悔的是被抓，而不是越过他们划下的界线。真正改变的是，我现在会把脚步藏得更好。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_generous.en: I cannot ask my household to endure that cost again merely to satisfy one more raid.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_generous.zh: 我不能只为满足又一次劫掠，就要求家臣和亲族再次承受那样的代价。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_impulsive.en: Whenever my temper rises, the memory of that punishment drags it down before I act.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_high_impulsive.zh: 每当怒火升起，那次惩罚的记忆都会在我行动以前把它压下去。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_cautious.en: I have no wish to face the Grey Wardens again over something as small as a village raid.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_cautious.zh: 我不想为了区区一次劫掠村庄，再去面对灰袍。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_closefisted.en: I lost more than I gained. I will not waste my own men and coin that way again.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_closefisted.zh: 我的损失超过了收获。我不会再这样浪费自己的士兵和钱财。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_dishonorabl.en: Rules are useful until they obstruct necessity. Being caught only proved that I chose the wrong moment.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_dishonorabl.zh: 规矩只有在不妨碍必要之事时才有用。被抓只能证明我选错了时机。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_generous.en: My followers paid for my choice as surely as I did. I owe them better judgment next time.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_generous.zh: 追随我的人和我一样为那个选择付出了代价。下一次，我有责任作出更好的判断。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_impulsive.en: I acted in anger and paid for it before the anger had even cooled.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_low_impulsive.zh: 我一时愤怒便采取了行动，怒气尚未消退，代价就已经找上了我。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_cautious.en: Call it caution if you like. I know how quickly they can close every road around a person.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_cautious.zh: 你尽可以把这叫作谨慎。我知道他们封死一个人身边所有道路的速度有多快。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_closefis.en: A burned village is not worth my soldiers, my coin, and my freedom all at once.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_closefis.zh: 烧毁一个村庄，不值得让我同时赔上士兵、钱财和自由。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_dishonor.en: I will not pretend their law was sacred. I learned only that breaking it openly gives enemies a weapon.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_dishonor.zh: 我不会假装他们的规矩不可冒犯。我只学会了一件事：公然破坏规矩，就是把武器递给敌人。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_generous.en: The people who followed me bore the losses of my decision. Loyalty requires that I not spend them so carelessly again.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_generous.zh: 追随我的人承担了那个决定造成的损失。忠义要求我不能再如此草率地牺牲他们。

gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_impulsiv.en: I let anger choose the road, and the Grey Wardens decided where that road ended.
gwp_ai_det_core_personal_medium_impulsiv.zh: 我让怒火替我选了道路，而灰袍决定了这条路在哪里结束。
