gwp_fief_reconsideration_support.zh: 灰袍已递交民间请愿，议会将重新审议谁应拥有{SETTLEMENT_NAME}。

gwp_fief_appeal_file.en: I wish to file a petition for reconsideration of a fief.
gwp_fief_appeal_file.zh: 我想为一块封地申请重新审议。

gwp_fief_appeal_recorded.en: I will enter the petition. The Noble Affairs Liaison will come to you personally before any fee is collected.
gwp_fief_appeal_recorded.zh: 我会登记这份请愿。在收取任何费用前，贵族事务协调官会亲自来见你。

gwp_fief_payment_offer.en: Your petition is in my hands. For fifty thousand denars paid into the Grey Warden public treasury, I will carry it to the people and reopen the fief decision.
gwp_fief_payment_offer.zh: 你的请愿已交到我手中。向灰袍公库支付五万第纳尔后，我会发动民间支持，并重新开启封地决议。

gwp_fief_payment_accept.en: Take the fifty thousand denars and proceed.
gwp_fief_payment_accept.zh: 收下这五万第纳尔，开始行动吧。

gwp_fief_payment_accepted.en: The sum is entered in the public treasury. I leave for the disputed fief at once.
gwp_fief_payment_accepted.zh: 款项已经记入公库。我现在就前往争议封地。

gwp_fief_payment_defer.en: Set the petition aside for now.

gwp_fief_payment_deferred.en: Very well. The petition will remain open. I will seek you out again when the time is right.
gwp_fief_payment_deferred.zh: 好。请愿会继续保留，时机合适时我会再来找你。

gwp_fief_payment_withdrawn.en: Then no payment is due, and the petition is closed.
gwp_fief_payment_withdrawn.zh: 那么无需支付费用，这份请愿就此关闭。

gwp_fief_payment_insufficient.en: You do not have the required fifty thousand denars. You may set the petition aside or withdraw it without payment.
gwp_fief_payment_insufficient.zh: 你没有准备好所需的五万第纳尔。可以暂时搁置请愿，也可以直接撤回，无需付款。

gwp_fief_select_description.en: Choose the recently captured fief whose ownership should be reconsidered.
gwp_fief_select_description.zh: 选择一座近期攻下、需要重新审议归属的城镇或城堡。

gwp_fief_select_hint.en: Captured with your participation and awarded to another clan.
gwp_fief_select_hint.zh: 你参加了这场攻城战，但封地最终授予了其他家族。

gwp_fief_auto_triggered.en: The Wardens' officer for noble affairs is on her way to see you.
gwp_fief_auto_triggered.zh: 灰袍的贵族事务官正前来见你。

gwp_fief_request_filed.en: Your petition for a fief is filed. The Wardens' officer for noble affairs is on her way to you.
gwp_fief_request_filed.zh: 封地请愿已经登记，贵族事务官正前来见你。

gwp_fief_vote_reopened.en: The Wardens have petitioned over {VAR_1}. The realm will deliberate the fief again, and you are among the candidates.
gwp_fief_vote_reopened.zh: 灰袍已就{VAR_1}提出请愿，王国将重新商议封地归属，你在候选之列。

gwp_fief_appeal_refunded.en: Your petition could not be brought forward. The fee has been returned in full.
gwp_fief_appeal_refunded.zh: 封地请愿未能提交，费用已全额退还。

gwp_player_troop_order_file.en: I want the Training Warden to prepare soldiers for my command.
gwp_player_troop_order_file.zh: 我想让练兵官为我准备一批士兵。

gwp_player_troop_order_recorded.en: Settle the price with me now, and I will send the order. The Training Warden will train real troops and bring them to you when they are ready.
gwp_player_troop_order_recorded.zh: 价钱当场结清，我这就把单子送出去。练兵长会把兵训好，亲自给你送来。

gwp_player_troop_delivery_offer.en: Your order is ready: {VAR_1} {VAR_2}. The {VAR_3} denars were settled when you placed it; nothing further is owed.
gwp_player_troop_delivery_offer.zh: 你要的兵已经齐了：{VAR_1} 名{VAR_2}。{VAR_3} 第纳尔在你下单那天就结清了，不欠什么。

gwp_player_troop_delivery_accept.en: Then place them under my command.
gwp_player_troop_delivery_accept.zh: 那就把他们交到我手上吧。

gwp_player_troop_delivery_accepted.en: They are yours. These soldiers now answer to you.
gwp_player_troop_delivery_accepted.zh: 人归你了。从今往后他们听你的。

gwp_player_troop_delivery_cancel.en: Cancel the order. Keep the soldiers.

gwp_player_troop_delivery_cancelled.en: Then no payment is due. They return to ordinary Grey Warden service.
gwp_player_troop_delivery_cancelled.zh: 那么无需付款，他们会回到灰袍的日常勤务中。

gwp_player_troop_order_description.en: Your Grey Warden standing sets the maximum order and available branches.
gwp_player_troop_order_description.zh: 你在灰袍中的声望决定订单上限和可选兵种。

gwp_player_troop_order_filed.en: The Training Warden has your order and will bring the soldiers to you once they are ready.
gwp_player_troop_order_filed.zh: 练兵领主已收到订单，训练完成后会送到你身边。

gwp_player_request_unknown_liaison.zh: 未知的贵族事务协调官

gwp_player_request_ledger_lobbying.en: Task type: player fief appeal | Fee: {VAR_1} | Public support: {VAR_2}% | Remaining stay: {VAR_3} hours
gwp_player_request_ledger_lobbying.zh: 任务类型：玩家封地申诉 | 费用：{VAR_1} | 民间支持：{VAR_2}% | 剩余驻留：{VAR_3}小时

gwp_player_request_ledger_detail.en: Task type: player fief appeal | Fee: {VAR_1} | Public support: {VAR_2}%
gwp_player_request_ledger_detail.zh: 任务类型：玩家封地申诉 | 费用：{VAR_1} | 民间支持：{VAR_2}%

gwp_player_request_stage_payment.zh: 正在前往玩家身边收款

gwp_player_request_stage_vote.zh: 新的封地投票已经开启

gwp_fief_defer_complete.en: The officer for noble affairs will return to take up your petition.
gwp_fief_defer_complete.zh: 贵族事务官将回来继续处理你的封地请愿。

gwp_player_troop_ledger_detail.en: Task type: player troop order | Ready: {VAR_1}/{VAR_2} | Paid on order: {VAR_3} denars
gwp_player_troop_ledger_detail.zh: 任务类型：玩家订兵 | 已备：{VAR_1}/{VAR_2} | 下单已付：{VAR_3} 第纳尔

gwp_player_troop_stage_delivery.zh: 正在前往玩家身边交付

gwp_fieldarrest_open.en: Stand where you are. I speak for the Grey Wardens.
gwp_fieldarrest_open.zh: 我受灰袍委托，为你名下的一件案子而来。

gwp_fieldarrest_charge.en: The Grey Wardens charge you with {VAR_1}, against {VAR_2}. The fine is {VAR_3} denars. They sent me to settle this.
gwp_fieldarrest_charge.zh: 灰袍指控你曾{VAR_1}，受害方是{VAR_2}。应缴罚金 {VAR_3} 第纳尔，我受托来处理这件事。

gwp_fieldarrest_walk_away.en: Never mind. Go on your way.

gwp_fieldarrest_victim_unknown.zh: 灰袍记录在案的受害人

gwp_fieldarrest_crime_caravan.en: attacking a caravan under Warden protection

gwp_fieldarrest_crime_village.en: violence against villagers under Warden protection
gwp_fieldarrest_crime_village.zh: 对灰袍保护的村民动手

gwp_fieldarrest_msg_fine.en: {VAR_1} pays the fine of {VAR_2} denars in full. The money belongs to the Wardens and must be handed to a Warden lord.
gwp_fieldarrest_msg_fine.zh: {VAR_1}缴清了 {VAR_2} 第纳尔罚金，须交给灰袍领主。

gwp_field_fine_handed_in.zh: 已上缴罚金 {VAR_1} 第纳尔。

gwp_field_settle_notice_body.en: The pursuit has ended. You must account for the commission and deliver the {VAR_1} denars collected as fines. Report to a Grey Warden lord; any shortfall must also be explained.
gwp_field_settle_notice_body.zh: 追捕已结束。你需要交代这次办案的结果，并上缴作为罚金收到的 {VAR_1} 第纳尔。请找灰袍领主交付；未收足的部分也要说明。

gwp_field_turnin_lord.zh: 罚金已点清，案子销了。灰袍收下 {VAR_1} 第纳尔，你的办案酬劳是 {VAR_2}。

gwp_fieldarrest_msg_partial.en: {VAR_1} pays only {VAR_2} of the {VAR_3} denars owed. Hand what you collected to a Warden lord.
gwp_fieldarrest_msg_partial.zh: {VAR_1}只缴了 {VAR_2} 第纳尔，应缴 {VAR_3} 第纳尔。所收罚金须交给灰袍领主。

gwp_fieldarrest_msg_captured.zh: {VAR_1} 落在你手里。案底与声望罚款一并结清；把俘虏交给灰袍领主。

gwp_fieldarrest_seize.zh: 我要依照通缉令，抓你归案。

gwp_fieldarrest_seize_reply.zh: 原来灰袍就这点分量。动手吧。

gwp_fa_open_under_charge.en: You work for the Wardens? Tell me what you want.
gwp_fa_open_under_charge.zh: 你替灰袍办事？说吧，找我什么事。

gwp_fa_open_respected_known.en: You again. Or your order, at least. What is it this time?
gwp_fa_open_respected_known.zh: 又见面了。我知道你替灰袍办过不少事。这回为了什么？

gwp_fa_open_respected.en: I know the grey. Speak, and speak plainly.
gwp_fa_open_respected.zh: 我听说过你。既然受灰袍委托，就把来意说清楚。

gwp_fa_open_known.en: The Wardens again. I remember the last time.
gwp_fa_open_known.zh: 灰袍又来了。上次的事，我可还记得。

gwp_fa_open_plain.en: The Wardens. What do you want with me?

gwp_fa_submit_upright.zh: 这件事我认，罚金也照数交。请把交款记清楚。

gwp_fa_submit_cold.zh: 比另一条路便宜。就这一个理由，你我都清楚。

gwp_fa_submit_soft.zh: 钱补不回那些损失。至少这笔罚金，我愿意交。

gwp_fa_submit_tight.zh: 钱都在这里了。点清楚，别再为这一笔来找我。

gwp_fa_submit_fierce.zh: 行，给钱。别当成我怕了你。

gwp_fa_plead_cold.zh: 你张口就是这个数。军饷、草料、换马——你看看这支队伍，钱能藏在哪儿？

gwp_fa_plead_tight.zh: 不管你们账上怎么写，我不是有钱人。你在我身上搜不出来。

gwp_fa_plead_plain.zh: 这个数？我身上没有。行李你要翻就翻。

gwp_fa_resist_scorn.zh: 你自己那笔账还没清，倒来收我的？拔剑吧。

gwp_fa_resist_fierce.zh: 我这辈子没花钱买过路。拔剑。

gwp_fa_resist_cold.zh: 你那支队伍我数过了，我自己的我也数过了。不给。

gwp_fa_resist_tight.zh: 一个子儿你也别想拿走。一个都别想。

gwp_fa_task_final.en: You have run out of words, Warden.

gwp_fa_task_later.en: I will hear no more arguments about this warrant.
gwp_fa_task_later.zh: 这份案子，我不想再听你争辩了。

gwp_fa_task_authority.en: You are not my liege and you are not a Warden. You are a man they hired.
gwp_fa_task_authority.zh: 你不是我的主君，也不是灰袍。你是他们雇来的人。

gwp_fa_arg_authority_lead.en: The Wardens sent me to deal with this. I am conveying their demand.
gwp_fa_arg_authority_lead.zh: 灰袍派我来处理这件事。我说的话，就是她们的要求。

gwp_fa_arg_authority_charm.en: Hired or sworn, the dead are still dead and someone had to come.
gwp_fa_arg_authority_charm.zh: 我受谁雇用，不会改变受害者的损失。我们先把这件事说清楚。

gwp_fa_arg_authority_rogue.en: They hired me because they were tired of asking politely.
gwp_fa_arg_authority_rogue.zh: 灰袍把案子交给我，就不会因为你不认我而撤回去。

gwp_fa_arg_authority_trade.en: Whether you accept me or not, the Wardens will still demand payment. Settling now saves you trouble.
gwp_fa_arg_authority_trade.zh: 你认不认我，灰袍要求的赔偿都不会少。趁现在把事情解决，对你也省事。

gwp_fa_task_under_charge.en: Your reputation is scarcely better than mine. Now you lecture me for the Wardens?
gwp_fa_task_under_charge.zh: 你的名声也没比我好多少，倒来替灰袍教训我了？

gwp_fa_arg_under_lead.en: My conduct is a separate matter. You must answer to the Wardens for this.
gwp_fa_arg_under_lead.zh: 我做过什么，不妨另说。眼前这些事，你得向灰袍交代。

gwp_fa_arg_under_charm.en: Then let us avoid another bad outcome. Settle this today so everyone can go home.
gwp_fa_arg_under_charm.zh: 那就别再添一个坏结果了。今天把事情解决，让大家都能回去。

gwp_fa_arg_under_rogue.en: That gives me all the more reason not to return empty-handed. Think carefully.
gwp_fa_arg_under_rogue.zh: 正因为如此，我更不会空手回去。你最好想清楚。

gwp_fa_arg_under_trade.en: Talking about me saves you not one denar. It does not reduce what you owe.
gwp_fa_arg_under_trade.zh: 议论我值不了一枚第纳尔。你该付的钱不会因此减少。

gwp_fa_task_price.en: And that number - where did it come from? You say it as if it fell from the sky.
gwp_fa_task_price.zh: 这个数——哪儿来的？你说得像是天上掉下来的。

gwp_fa_arg_price_lead.en: This is the fine the Wardens demand. I was sent to enforce it, not invent a price.
gwp_fa_arg_price_lead.zh: 这是灰袍要求的罚金。我受托来执行，不是来随口开价的。

gwp_fa_arg_price_charm.en: The victims have already borne the loss. Do not add another fight to it.
gwp_fa_arg_price_charm.zh: 受害者已经承担了损失。别再为这件事添一场厮杀。

gwp_fa_arg_price_rogue.en: It is the cheap answer. You are looking at the expensive one.
gwp_fa_arg_price_rogue.zh: 这是便宜那条路。贵的那条正看着你。

gwp_fa_arg_price_trade.en: The damage and the people harmed both need answering for. This sum covers more than this one encounter.
gwp_fa_arg_price_trade.zh: 损毁的财物、受害的人，都得有个交代。这个数不是只算你眼前这一次。

gwp_fa_task_tally.en: You are charging me for things I did months apart, as if they were one crime.
gwp_fa_task_tally.zh: 为什么把几次事情合在一起，收我这么一大笔钱？

gwp_fa_arg_tally_lead.en: Time passing does not remove your responsibility. The Wardens hold you answerable for all of it.
gwp_fa_arg_tally_lead.zh: 事情过去了，不等于责任也没了。灰袍要你一起承担。

gwp_fa_arg_tally_charm.en: Each one had people in it. They were months apart for you, not for them.
gwp_fa_arg_tally_charm.zh: 每一件里都有人。对你是隔了几个月，对他们不是。

gwp_fa_arg_tally_rogue.en: If you wanted them charged separately you should have been caught sooner.
gwp_fa_arg_tally_rogue.zh: 想一件一件算，早点被逮住就是了。

gwp_fa_arg_tally_trade.en: Settle these offences together today and spare your party repeated interruptions over them.
gwp_fa_arg_tally_trade.zh: 今天一起付清，就不用为这些旧事反复停下队伍。

gwp_fa_task_denial.en: My men did that. I did not give the order, and I will not pay for their appetite.
gwp_fa_task_denial.zh: 那是我手下干的。我没下这个令，凭什么让我替他们的胃口付钱。

gwp_fa_arg_denial_lead.en: They are your men. That is what the word means.
gwp_fa_arg_denial_lead.zh: 那是你的兵。手下两个字就是这个意思。

gwp_fa_arg_denial_charm.en: Nobody in that village could tell your hand from theirs.
gwp_fa_arg_denial_charm.zh: 村里没一个人分得清是你的手还是他们的手。

gwp_fa_arg_denial_rogue.en: They acted under your banner. Blame your men, and the Wardens will still come for you.
gwp_fa_arg_denial_rogue.zh: 他们打着你的旗号行事。推给部下，灰袍也还是会找你。

gwp_fa_arg_denial_trade.en: They are your men. Pay for the harm first; how you recover it from them is your affair.
gwp_fa_arg_denial_trade.zh: 他们是你的部下。先把损失赔了，你回去怎么向他们追究，是你的事。

gwp_fa_task_war.en: There is a war on. Taking an enemy's goods is not a crime, it is the work.
gwp_fa_task_war.zh: 打着仗呢。拿敌方的东西不算犯罪，那叫干活。

gwp_fa_arg_war_lead.en: Your war does not reach the drivers. The Wardens' law does.
gwp_fa_arg_war_lead.zh: 你的仗轮不到赶车的头上。灰袍的律轮得到。

gwp_fa_arg_war_charm.en: Carters and guards. Not one of them was holding your line.
gwp_fa_arg_war_charm.zh: 车夫和护卫。没有一个是替你守过阵线的。

gwp_fa_arg_war_rogue.en: Call it war if it helps. The Wardens call it a caravan and a body count.
gwp_fa_arg_war_rogue.zh: 你愿意叫它打仗就叫吧。灰袍这边写的是一支商队和几具尸首。

gwp_fa_arg_war_trade.en: Wars end. Accounts do not, until someone pays them.
gwp_fa_arg_war_trade.zh: 仗会打完。账不会，除非有人付。

gwp_fa_task_consequence.en: And if I simply refuse to pay? What can you do about it?
gwp_fa_task_consequence.zh: 我要是干脆不交呢？你还能把我怎么样？

gwp_fa_arg_consequence_lead.en: My departure would not make the Wardens drop this. We need an answer today.
gwp_fa_arg_consequence_lead.zh: 我离开了，灰袍也不会就此罢手。今天总得有个交代。

gwp_fa_arg_consequence_charm.en: Then the next grey rider is not here to talk, and neither of us wants that.
gwp_fa_arg_consequence_charm.zh: 那下一个穿灰的来就不是找你说话了，这对谁都不好。

gwp_fa_arg_consequence_rogue.en: You can wager that I cannot take you. You cannot choose how many Wardens come next time.
gwp_fa_arg_consequence_rogue.zh: 你可以赌我拿不住你。下回灰袍来多少人，你可说了不算。

gwp_fa_arg_consequence_trade.en: The debt remains until it is settled. Waiting does not make it disappear.
gwp_fa_arg_consequence_trade.zh: 这笔欠款会一直留着，不会因为你拖延就消失。

gwp_fa_task_record.en: Your order has had me once already. Is this how it goes now - forever?
gwp_fa_task_record.zh: 你们抓过我一回了。以后就这么没完了是吗？

gwp_fa_arg_record_lead.en: It goes until you stop giving them cause. That part is yours.
gwp_fa_arg_record_lead.zh: 你不再给他们理由，就完了。这一半在你手上。

gwp_fa_arg_record_charm.en: They took you once and let you ride. Few orders would have.
gwp_fa_arg_record_charm.zh: 抓了一回还放你走的团，不多。

gwp_fa_arg_record_rogue.en: You know how an arrest ends. Do you want to go through that again?
gwp_fa_arg_record_rogue.zh: 被捕是什么结果，你已经经历过。还要再来一回吗？

gwp_fa_arg_record_trade.en: Pay what is assessed now. Any future offence will have its own reckoning.
gwp_fa_arg_record_trade.zh: 先结清眼下这笔。以后再犯的事，另有新的账。

gwp_fieldarrest_war_mediated.zh: 灰袍调停：案子已经了结，由此与{VAR_1}结下的战事就此停息。

gwp_fa_desire_bribe.en: Property worth {GWP_BRIBE_AMOUNT} denars, for you alone. What you tell the Wardens is your affair.
gwp_fa_desire_bribe.zh: 我给你价值 {GWP_BRIBE_AMOUNT} 第纳尔的财物，归你自己。回去怎么说，你来想办法。

gwp_fa_desire_duel.en: Fight me alone. If you win, I pay the fine; if I win, you collect nothing.
gwp_fa_desire_duel.zh: 你我单挑。你赢了，我缴罚金；我赢了，你就不收这笔钱。

gwp_fa_l1_failed.en: Enough. Your order has no claim on me, and neither do you.
gwp_fa_l1_failed.zh: 我不接受这份指控，你也休想凭几句话让我低头。

gwp_fa_l1_done.en: ...Very well. I answer to the charge. The question is how.
gwp_fa_l1_done.zh: 好，我接受这次处置。接下来谈谈怎么了结。

gwp_fa_l1_lost.en: I reject this demand from the Wardens. If you insist on force, draw.
gwp_fa_l1_lost.zh: 我不接受灰袍这次处置。你执意动手，就拔剑吧。

gwp_fa_take_by_force.en: I will enforce the warrant by force.
gwp_fa_take_by_force.zh: 我要强制执行通缉令，拿下你。

gwp_fa_leave_it.en: Ride on, then. This is not finished.

gwp_fa_l2_agreed.zh: 那就照数全缴，没别的话说。

gwp_fa_l2_failed.en: No. I have told you how this will go.
gwp_fa_l2_failed.zh: 全额我不答应。我能接受的条件已经告诉你了。

gwp_fa_l2_done.en: ...The full sum, then. Have it your way.

gwp_fa_l2_lost.zh: 我的条件不变。你愿意就照办，不愿意就动手。

gwp_fa_take_anyway.en: Keep your silver. I am taking you in.
gwp_fa_take_anyway.zh: 你的银子留着。人我带走。

gwp_fa_settled_line.zh: 点清了。现在从我路上让开。

gwp_fa_desire_payfull.en: Very well. The full sum, and we are finished here.

gwp_fa_desire_surrender.en: That silver is my men's wages. Take me instead - I ride with you, and they go home.
gwp_fa_desire_surrender.zh: 那些银子是我部下的军饷。你带我走吧——我跟你，让他们回家。

gwp_fa_desire_cunning.en: Half. That is what the baggage carries, and that is what you are getting.
gwp_fa_desire_cunning.zh: 一半。辎重里就这么多，你能拿到的也就这么多。

gwp_fa_desire_rash.en: Take four fifths of the fine and let us finish this.
gwp_fa_desire_rash.zh: 八成交给你。就这么了结，别再争了。

gwp_fa_desire_deeds.en: I will pay two fifths. The men I blame will answer to me with their lives.
gwp_fa_desire_deeds.zh: 我只交四成。那些惹事的部下，我会当场处死，给你一个交代。

gwp_fa_desire_haggle.en: I will give you seven tenths of the fine. That is my offer.
gwp_fa_desire_haggle.zh: 我最多出七成。你愿意收，我们就此了结。

gwp_fa_accept_payfull.en: The full sum. Hand it over.

gwp_fa_accept_surrender.en: Then ride with me. Your men can find their own way.
gwp_fa_accept_surrender.zh: 那就跟我走。你的人自己想办法。

gwp_fa_accept_bribe.en: Hand it over. This conversation did not happen.
gwp_fa_accept_bribe.zh: 拿过来。这段话没发生过。

gwp_fa_accept_cunning.en: Half, then. The rest stays against your name.
gwp_fa_accept_cunning.zh: 我收这一半，剩下的差额也会写进报告。

gwp_fa_accept_rash.en: Most of it will do. The remainder stays on the account.
gwp_fa_accept_rash.zh: 八成我收下，短缺的数目一并记下。

gwp_fa_accept_duel.en: Draw, then. Let us settle it between us.
gwp_fa_accept_duel.zh: 那就拔剑。你我之间了结。

gwp_fa_accept_deeds.en: Pay for the deed, then. The dead stay on your record.
gwp_fa_accept_deeds.zh: 那就为你做下的事付钱。那些人命的账留着。

gwp_fa_accept_haggle.en: Seven tenths, then. I will have to account for the shortfall.
gwp_fa_accept_haggle.zh: 七成就七成。剩下的差额，我回去交代。

gwp_fieldarrest_msg_surrender.en: {VAR_1} surrenders. Deliver him to a Warden lord.
gwp_fieldarrest_msg_surrender.zh: {VAR_1}投降了。请将他押交灰袍领主。

gwp_fieldarrest_msg_bribe.zh: {VAR_1}私下塞给你价值 {VAR_2} 第纳尔的财物。

gwp_fieldarrest_msg_own_men.en: He has several of his own men put to death before you to bear the blame.
gwp_fieldarrest_msg_own_men.zh: 他当着你的面处决了几名手下顶罪。

gwp_fieldarrest_msg_duel_lost.en: {VAR_1} wins the duel, and you let him go as agreed.

gwp_fieldarrest_msg_duel_won.zh: 你赢了单挑，向 {VAR_1} 收到 {VAR_2} 第纳尔。若未收足，交账时仍需说明。

gwp_report_open.zh: 我有一笔路上办案收来的罚金要交代。

gwp_report_ask.zh: 卷宗要一个数。他交了你多少？

gwp_report_no_money.zh: 他身上榨不出什么东西。

gwp_report_no_money_reply.zh: 那卷宗上就这么记。暂且。

gwp_report_result_short.zh: 卷宗上写的是 {VAR_1}。你交上来 {VAR_2}。这个差额你自己担着。

gwp_report_short.zh: 卷宗写的是 {VAR_1}，你交上来 {VAR_2}。灰袍声望 {VAR_3}。

gwp_report_exposed.zh: 灰袍拿下了 {VAR_1}，他的钱袋和你当初说的对不上。灰袍声望 {VAR_2}。

gwp_det_ui_ledger_clean.zh: 灰袍账目：没有未清的账。

gwp_det_ui_ledger_case.en: Open case: {VAR_1} deed(s), {VAR_2} dead on this case alone.
gwp_det_ui_ledger_case.zh: 未结案件：{VAR_1} 起；仅这件案子就死了 {VAR_2} 人。

gwp_det_ui_ledger_standing_lives.en: Civilian lives still on his record: {VAR_1}.
gwp_det_ui_ledger_standing_lives.zh: 尚未赎清的人命：{VAR_1} 条。

gwp_det_ui_ledger_no_case.en: No case is open against him, but the charge for the dead stands until it is paid off or he is taken.
gwp_det_ui_ledger_no_case.zh: 目前没有正在追捕的案件；若有待交付的罚金，交账后才会抵扣欠款。剿匪赎过也可能减少负声望。

gwp_case_payment.en: Case fines delivered to the judicial treasury
gwp_case_payment.zh: 向灰袍司法公库上缴罚金

gwp_case_captive_ready.en: You hold the target captive. Deliver him to any Warden lord to collect the reward.
gwp_case_captive_ready.zh: 目标已被你俘获。将他押交任意一位灰袍领主即可领取赏金。

gwp_case_closed_elsewhere.en: {VAR_1} is beyond your reach now. The commission is void. Report to any Grey Warden lord, or send a man.
gwp_case_closed_elsewhere.zh: {VAR_1}已经不在你能追到的地方了。委托到此为止。去找任意灰袍领主复命，或者派个人去。

gwp_case_report_open.en: I have come to report on the commission.
gwp_case_report_open.zh: 我来交代上次受托办的案子。

gwp_case_deliver_money.zh: 罚金带来了，我们点一下。

gwp_case_report_poverty.zh: 他确实付不起全额。我把收到的钱交上来，你们可以查。

gwp_case_report_zero.zh: 这次我没有钱上缴，差额记在我名下。

gwp_case_missing_prisoner.zh: 俘虏已经不在我手里了。这笔酬劳我领不了。

gwp_case_report_later.en: I am not ready to hand it over yet.
gwp_case_report_later.zh: 钱和人还没有准备好，我改日再来。

gwp_case_barter_accepted.en: We have counted the payment. Your report will be entered.
gwp_case_barter_accepted.zh: 钱物清点好了，这份委托可以结了。

gwp_case_barter_cancelled.en: Nothing has been entered. We can count it again when you are ready.
gwp_case_barter_cancelled.zh: 这次没有入账。你准备好了，我们再点。

gwp_case_report_summary.en: The account lists {VAR_1} denars. Have you brought the fines, or the prisoner? If any money is missing, tell me why.
gwp_case_report_summary.zh: 卷宗上记着 {VAR_1} 第纳尔。你带来了罚金，还是把人押来了？钱若有短缺，也请说清缘由。

gwp_case_missing_result.zh: 人没有交到，办案酬劳就不能发。这份委托到此结束。

gwp_case_report_complete.en: Your report is entered. The treasury has paid {VAR_1} denars in expenses. This commission is concluded.
gwp_case_report_complete.zh: 交付已经记下。公库付给你 {VAR_1} 第纳尔办案酬劳，这份委托结清了。

gwp_case_capture_failed.en: The target was not taken. The case remains open.
gwp_case_capture_failed.zh: 目标未被俘获，案件尚未了结。

gwp_case_cash_with_prisoner.zh: 你之前还向他收过 {VAR_1} 第纳尔。把这笔钱补齐，和俘虏一起交来。

gwp_case_cash_still_due.zh: 俘虏已经不在你手里，但先前收下的罚金仍要交代。

gwp_case_purse_short.en: I accept the fine, but my money and goods together are worth only {VAR_1} denars. That is what I can give now.
gwp_case_purse_short.zh: 罚金我认，可我身边的钱和东西合起来只值 {VAR_1} 第纳尔。现在能交的就是这些。

gwp_case_collect_amount.en: Present property worth {VAR_1} denars. I will report the payment and any shortfall.
gwp_case_collect_amount.zh: 拿出价值 {VAR_1} 第纳尔的财物。实收和短缺我会回报。

gwp_fa_payment_budget.zh: 我还得发军饷、买粮草。交了这笔钱，我拿什么养这些人？

gwp_fa_payment_budget_lead.zh: 他们由你统率，闯的祸也该由你负责。交清罚金，别再把他们卷进来。

gwp_fa_payment_budget_charm.zh: 他们需要你平安带队回去。眼下还不必为这笔钱再死人。

gwp_fa_payment_budget_rogue.zh: 想想打输一仗会丢掉什么。到时候你心疼的就不只是这袋钱了。

gwp_fa_payment_budget_trade.zh: 补兵、换马、添置装备都要钱。和这些开销比，眼下缴清更合算。

gwp_fa_payment_terms.zh: 我已经开了条件，为什么非得按你说的全额交？

gwp_fa_payment_terms_lead.zh: 我受托收的是这笔罚金。你另开的条件，不能替我向灰袍交差。

gwp_fa_payment_terms_charm.zh: 你已经认了这件事。把它妥善了结，我们也就不必为此交战。

gwp_fa_payment_terms_rogue.zh: 你少交的钱，要我回去担责。我不会替你背这笔账。

gwp_fa_payment_terms_trade.zh: 缴清后，我交账时能替你抵清这笔欠款。只交一部分，余下的还记在你名下。

gwp_case_pending_encyclopedia.en: Fine assessed: {VAR_1} denars. Paid by the offender: {VAR_2}.
gwp_case_pending_encyclopedia.zh: 本次罚金：{VAR_1} 第纳尔。犯人已缴：{VAR_2} 第纳尔。

gwp_case_duel_post_win.en: You won. I accept it. Inspect my property and let us settle the fine as agreed.
gwp_case_duel_post_win.zh: 你赢了，我认。照约定，看看我的财物，把罚金结清吧。

gwp_case_duel_post_loss.en: You lost. As agreed, you collect no fine from me today.
gwp_case_duel_post_loss.zh: 你输了。按约定，今天你不能向我收这笔罚金。

gwp_case_duel_post_reply.en: I will report the outcome to the Grey Wardens.
gwp_case_duel_post_reply.zh: 我会把结果向灰袍回报。

gwp_case_barter_count.en: Let us check what you have brought.
gwp_case_barter_count.zh: 让我清点一下你带来的东西和人。

gwp_fa_refuse_strength.en: I will not accept this demand. We have nothing to discuss.
gwp_fa_refuse_strength.zh: 灰袍这次的要求，我不接受。我们没什么好谈的。

gwp_fa_hear_charge.en: I have heard the charge. First tell me why I should answer to you.
gwp_fa_hear_charge.zh: 指控我听见了。不过，你先说说，我为什么要接受你的处置？

gwp_fa_request_terms.en: Then tell me how you propose to settle this.
gwp_fa_request_terms.zh: 那就说吧，你打算怎么了结？

gwp_fa_counter_offer.en: Those terms will not do. Let us discuss the full fine.
gwp_fa_counter_offer.zh: 这个条件我不能接受。我们谈谈照数缴清的事。

gwp_fa_count_money.en: Here are the money and goods. Choose what you will take.
gwp_fa_count_money.zh: 钱和东西都在这里，你来挑。

gwp_fa_collection_paid.en: The money is counted. We are done here.
gwp_fa_collection_paid.zh: 钱点清了。今天就到这里。

gwp_fa_collection_empty.en: See for yourself. There is no money or property left to give you.
gwp_fa_collection_empty.zh: 你自己看吧，已经没有能交给你的钱和东西了。

gwp_fa_accept_empty.en: I will report that you could not pay. Your debt remains.
gwp_fa_accept_empty.zh: 我会如实回报你付不起钱，欠账仍记在你名下。

gwp_fa_collection_cancel.en: No payment has changed hands. What do you intend to do?
gwp_fa_collection_cancel.zh: 钱还没交出去。你到底打算怎么办？

gwp_fa_accept_count.en: Show me the money and goods. We will agree what they cover.
gwp_fa_accept_count.zh: 把钱和东西拿出来，能抵多少，我们当面说清。

gwp_terms_final_objection.en: And if I pay the full amount, what do I gain by giving up my terms?
gwp_terms_final_objection.zh: 就算照数交清，我放弃刚才的条件，又能换来什么？

gwp_terms_final_lead.en: Your command stays with you. I need the account settled, not another battle.
gwp_terms_final_lead.zh: 你仍带你的队伍。我来是为了结清这笔账，不是再打一仗。

gwp_terms_final_charm.en: We both leave with our people alive. That is worth more than prolonging this quarrel.
gwp_terms_final_charm.zh: 双方的人都能活着离开。这比继续争执要紧。

gwp_terms_final_rogue.en: You remove the reason I am standing in your path. Do you really want to wager more?
gwp_terms_final_rogue.zh: 把这笔钱付了，我今天就没有拦你的理由。你还想赌上更多？

gwp_terms_final_trade.en: An exact payment leaves no remainder to argue over when I deliver the account.
gwp_terms_final_trade.zh: 交清了，回报时就不会还挂着一笔余款。

gwp_fa_desire_cautious.en: Keep your weapons lowered. I will pay what you ask; there need be no battle.
gwp_fa_desire_cautious.zh: 先把武器放下。钱我照数交，没必要打这一仗。

gwp_fa_desire_merciful.en: Enough people have suffered. Take the full fine, and let there be no more bloodshed.
gwp_fa_desire_merciful.zh: 已经够多人受苦了。罚金我全交，别再流血了。

gwp_fa_desire_generous.en: I can spare the silver. Take the full amount and see that this account is settled.
gwp_fa_desire_generous.zh: 这笔钱我拿得出。照数拿去，把账结清。

gwp_report_audit_found.en: The Wardens find {VAR_1} denars missing from your accounts.
gwp_report_audit_found.zh: 灰袍查出你上交的账目短缺 {VAR_1} 第纳尔。

gwp_case_false_payment.zh: 【撒谎】只收上来这些，剩下的他实在付不起。我们点一下。

gwp_case_false_zero.zh: 【撒谎】他身无分文，我一分钱也没收到。

gwp_case_prisoner_hide.zh: 【隐瞒】人交给你们。我没有向他收过钱。

gwp_case_prisoner_partial.zh: 【隐瞒】人和账上这笔钱一起交给你们。

gwp_case_full_payment.zh: 足额的 {VAR_1} 第纳尔都在这里，把账结清吧。

gwp_case_true_payment.zh: 实际收了 {VAR_1} 第纳尔，我全部交上来。剩下的没能收到，我如实回报。

gwp_case_prisoner_cash.zh: 人交给你们，先前向他收过的 {VAR_1} 第纳尔也一并交上。

gwp_case_truthful_poor_result.zh: 实收的 {VAR_1} 第纳尔已经入账。他付不起的余款仍记在他名下，不追究你。办案酬劳为 {VAR_2} 第纳尔，委托结清。

gwp_case_truthful_gap_result.zh: 实收的 {VAR_1} 第纳尔已经入账。未能收足的差额按办案责任记下。办案酬劳为 {VAR_2} 第纳尔，委托结清。

gwp_case_transfer_retry.zh: 交付暂时没办成，钱已退回。你仍保管俘虏和款项，换一位灰袍领主再办。

gwp_terms_surrenderself_lead.en: Your men also need their commander. Paying keeps you at their head.
gwp_terms_surrenderself_lead.zh: 你的部下也需要统帅。交钱了结，你仍能带着他们。

gwp_terms_surrenderself_charm.en: You need not leave your people behind. Pay, and stay with them.
gwp_terms_surrenderself_charm.zh: 不必把自己人丢下。交清罚金，你就能留在他们身边。

gwp_terms_surrenderself_rogue.en: Do you trust whoever commands in your absence? Silver is easier to replace.
gwp_terms_surrenderself_rogue.zh: 你放心把指挥权交给别人？钱可比你的位子容易找回来。

gwp_terms_surrenderself_trade.en: Captivity will cost your household and command as well. Settle in silver today.
gwp_terms_surrenderself_trade.zh: 被关押也会拖累家族和队伍。用现钱了结，损失更可控。

gwp_terms_bribethewarden_lead.en: I carry a warrant, not a begging bowl. Pay what it names.
gwp_terms_bribethewarden_lead.zh: 灰袍让我来收罚金，不是收你的好处。该交多少就交多少。

gwp_terms_bribethewarden_charm.en: Do not put this between us. Settle openly and we can both ride away.
gwp_terms_bribethewarden_charm.zh: 别把事情弄成这样。光明正大地交清，双方都能走。

gwp_terms_bribethewarden_rogue.en: You want me to risk my name for your loose change. Keep the bribe and bring the fine.
gwp_terms_bribethewarden_rogue.zh: 拿这点私钱换我背锅？贿金收回去，罚金拿出来。

gwp_terms_bribethewarden_trade.en: A private purse does not settle a public debt. The full account still needs paying.
gwp_terms_bribethewarden_trade.zh: 私下给我的钱抵不了公库的账。该缴的总数并没变。

gwp_terms_cunninghalf_lead.en: Then open the other baggage. I will not accept your word for half an account.
gwp_terms_cunninghalf_lead.zh: 那就把别的行李也打开。我不会凭一句话就认下只剩一半。

gwp_terms_cunninghalf_charm.en: Show me enough trust to stop bargaining with a story about your purse.
gwp_terms_cunninghalf_charm.zh: 别再拿钱袋当借口。把实情说清，事情也好收场。

gwp_terms_cunninghalf_rogue.en: Half conveniently missing? I have heard that trick before. Find the rest.
gwp_terms_cunninghalf_rogue.zh: 刚好只剩一半？这套说辞我听过。把另一半找出来。

gwp_terms_cunninghalf_trade.en: Half the payment leaves half the account. Your story does not change the sum.
gwp_terms_cunninghalf_trade.zh: 付一半就还欠一半。你怎么解释钱袋，都改不了这个数。

gwp_terms_rashmost_lead.en: If you want this finished, finish the payment. Do not leave the last fifth hanging.
gwp_terms_rashmost_lead.zh: 真想快点了结，就把最后两成交齐。别留个尾巴。

gwp_terms_rashmost_charm.en: We are close enough to agreement. Do not throw it away over the remainder.
gwp_terms_rashmost_charm.zh: 已经谈到这一步了，别为最后一点余款闹翻。

gwp_terms_rashmost_rogue.en: You risk the whole purse to keep its last fifth. Think before you refuse.
gwp_terms_rashmost_rogue.zh: 为留下最后两成，把整只钱袋赌上？你再想想。

gwp_terms_rashmost_trade.en: You have offered four fifths. Add the remaining fifth and there is no balance left.
gwp_terms_rashmost_trade.zh: 八成已经答应了，再补两成，账就齐了。

gwp_terms_demandduel_lead.en: This warrant is not a contest. Meet the charge without risking your commander's life.
gwp_terms_demandduel_lead.zh: 这份通缉令不是比武请帖。别为它拿自己的命去赌。

gwp_terms_demandduel_charm.en: You need not prove your courage to me. Spare both our people another loss.
gwp_terms_demandduel_charm.zh: 你不必向我证明勇气。双方都少受一次伤，不好吗？

gwp_terms_demandduel_rogue.en: A duel lets you gamble away somebody else's debt. I will not take that wager.
gwp_terms_demandduel_rogue.zh: 拿单挑免掉别人的血债？这个赌法我不接。

gwp_terms_demandduel_trade.en: Even victory costs wounds and time. The fine is a known price; a duel is not.
gwp_terms_demandduel_trade.zh: 赢了也可能受伤耽误行程。罚金有定数，刀剑可没有。

gwp_terms_deedsonly_lead.en: Killing your own soldiers will not discharge your responsibility. Pay the full fine.
gwp_terms_deedsonly_lead.zh: 杀自己的兵也免不了你的责任。把罚金交齐。

gwp_terms_deedsonly_charm.en: There have been enough deaths. Keep your men alive and settle this in silver.
gwp_terms_deedsonly_charm.zh: 死的人已经够多了。留下他们的命，用钱了结。

gwp_terms_deedsonly_rogue.en: Cutting down witnesses does not make your account smaller. Do not pretend it does.
gwp_terms_deedsonly_rogue.zh: 砍掉几个知情人，账就会变少？别拿这个糊弄我。

gwp_terms_deedsonly_trade.en: Two fifths will not cover this account. Your men's lives are not a substitute for the rest.
gwp_terms_deedsonly_trade.zh: 四成填不平这笔账。你部下的命也抵不了剩下的钱。

gwp_terms_haggledown_lead.en: This is an assessed fine. I have no order to discount it by three tenths.
gwp_terms_haggledown_lead.zh: 这是核定的罚金，我没有给你打七折的命令。

gwp_terms_haggledown_charm.en: Let us end this without another quarrel. Pay the remainder as well.
gwp_terms_haggledown_charm.zh: 别再为余款起争执了，照数交齐吧。

gwp_terms_haggledown_rogue.en: You are bargaining as though I must sell. I can still enforce the warrant.
gwp_terms_haggledown_rogue.zh: 你以为我非卖给你不可？我还可以照令抓人。

gwp_terms_haggledown_trade.en: Seven tenths leaves three tenths unpaid. Close the balance now.
gwp_terms_haggledown_trade.zh: 七成交了还剩三成。把余款也结清。

gwp_fa_retry_payment.en: I still stand by my terms. Have you another proposal?
gwp_fa_retry_payment.zh: 我还是坚持刚才的条件。你还有别的说法吗？

gwp_fa_retry_authority.en: That is not enough for me to accept your authority. Have you another reason?
gwp_fa_retry_authority.zh: 这还不足以让我接受你的处置。你还有别的理由吗？

gwp_fa_critical_rebuff.en: Enough. I will hear no more of this.
gwp_fa_critical_rebuff.zh: 够了，这件事我不想再谈。

gwp_rebuff_authority_lead.en: Your warrant is not a command I have sworn to obey. Give me a better reason.
gwp_rebuff_authority_lead.zh: 我可没向这份通缉令宣过誓。你得拿出更能让我信服的理由。

gwp_rebuff_authority_charm.en: I hear your concern for them. That does not settle whether I answer to you.
gwp_rebuff_authority_charm.zh: 我听见你替他们说话了，但这还没说明我为什么该接受你的处置。

gwp_rebuff_authority_rogue.en: Threats are easy to make. I have not agreed to your authority.
gwp_rebuff_authority_rogue.zh: 威胁谁都会说。我还没答应听你的。

gwp_rebuff_authority_trade.en: You keep counting the fine before I have accepted the charge.
gwp_rebuff_authority_trade.zh: 你一直在算罚金，可我还没认下这份指控。

gwp_rebuff_surrenderself_lead.en: My answer is still to go with you. That money stays with my men.
gwp_rebuff_surrenderself_lead.zh: 正因为我是统帅，才该由我跟你走。钱留给部下。

gwp_rebuff_surrenderself_charm.en: My answer is still to go with you. That money stays with my men.
gwp_rebuff_surrenderself_charm.zh: 他们不会因为我被押走就没了活路，没了军饷才会。

gwp_rebuff_surrenderself_rogue.en: My answer is still to go with you. That money stays with my men.
gwp_rebuff_surrenderself_rogue.zh: 我离开后谁来指挥，自有安排。你不必替我操心。

gwp_rebuff_surrenderself_trade.en: My answer is still to go with you. That money stays with my men.
gwp_rebuff_surrenderself_trade.zh: 你算的是我的损失，我想的是他们明天吃什么。

gwp_rebuff_bribethewarden_lead.en: You can put a brave face on it. I am offering you a private payment, not the full fine.
gwp_rebuff_bribethewarden_lead.zh: 别急着拿通缉令压人。我说的是给你个人的好处。

gwp_rebuff_bribethewarden_charm.en: You can put a brave face on it. I am offering you a private payment, not the full fine.
gwp_rebuff_bribethewarden_charm.zh: 你我都能好好离开，何必非要把钱送进公库？

gwp_rebuff_bribethewarden_rogue.en: You can put a brave face on it. I am offering you a private payment, not the full fine.
gwp_rebuff_bribethewarden_rogue.zh: 嫌这点钱不值得冒险？那也是私下谈价，不是让我照数缴罚。

gwp_rebuff_bribethewarden_trade.en: You can put a brave face on it. I am offering you a private payment, not the full fine.
gwp_rebuff_bribethewarden_trade.zh: 公库的账是公库的账。我问的是你愿不愿意收这笔钱。

gwp_rebuff_cunninghalf_lead.en: You suspect another purse, but suspicion does not put more money on this table. Half is my offer.
gwp_rebuff_cunninghalf_lead.zh: 要翻行李就直说，但我不会因此改口答应全额。

gwp_rebuff_cunninghalf_charm.en: You suspect another purse, but suspicion does not put more money on this table. Half is my offer.
gwp_rebuff_cunninghalf_charm.zh: 信任不是你说一句，我就得掏出另一半。我的条件没变。

gwp_rebuff_cunninghalf_rogue.en: You suspect another purse, but suspicion does not put more money on this table. Half is my offer.
gwp_rebuff_cunninghalf_rogue.zh: 听过这种说辞，就能断定我还藏着钱？你得拿出点别的。

gwp_rebuff_cunninghalf_trade.en: You suspect another purse, but suspicion does not put more money on this table. Half is my offer.
gwp_rebuff_cunninghalf_trade.zh: 我知道半款还剩多少。我是在给你条件，不是在请你算数。

gwp_rebuff_rashmost_lead.en: I offered most of it to end this quickly. Now you want to keep arguing over the rest.
gwp_rebuff_rashmost_lead.zh: 我肯出八成，已经是让步。别把让步当成理所当然。

gwp_rebuff_rashmost_charm.en: I offered most of it to end this quickly. Now you want to keep arguing over the rest.
gwp_rebuff_rashmost_charm.zh: 既然只差这一点，你也可以让一步，何必全要我来让？

gwp_rebuff_rashmost_rogue.en: I offered most of it to end this quickly. Now you want to keep arguing over the rest.
gwp_rebuff_rashmost_rogue.zh: 我可没说要赌掉整只钱袋。你少拿最坏的事吓我。

gwp_rebuff_rashmost_trade.en: I offered most of it to end this quickly. Now you want to keep arguing over the rest.
gwp_rebuff_rashmost_trade.zh: 不用教我算那两成。我知道差多少，只是不想再给。

gwp_rebuff_demandduel_lead.en: All those reasons to avoid a duel. I still want this settled between the two of us.
gwp_rebuff_demandduel_lead.zh: 通缉令在你手上，剑也在你手上。为什么不敢亲自来了结？

gwp_rebuff_demandduel_charm.en: All those reasons to avoid a duel. I still want this settled between the two of us.
gwp_rebuff_demandduel_charm.zh: 你说不必证明勇气，我却不想靠掏钱结束这件事。

gwp_rebuff_demandduel_rogue.en: All those reasons to avoid a duel. I still want this settled between the two of us.
gwp_rebuff_demandduel_rogue.zh: 你不肯接这个赌，我也没答应换个办法。

gwp_rebuff_demandduel_trade.en: All those reasons to avoid a duel. I still want this settled between the two of us.
gwp_rebuff_demandduel_trade.zh: 你把伤口和行程都算进去了。我看重的可不只是钱。

gwp_rebuff_deedsonly_lead.en: Their punishment is mine to decide. I offered you two fifths, no more.
gwp_rebuff_deedsonly_lead.zh: 我的兵由我处置。你来收你的钱，别替我发号施令。

gwp_rebuff_deedsonly_charm.en: Their punishment is mine to decide. I offered you two fifths, no more.
gwp_rebuff_deedsonly_charm.zh: 你想替他们求情？那也不会让我多交余下的罚金。

gwp_rebuff_deedsonly_rogue.en: Their punishment is mine to decide. I offered you two fifths, no more.
gwp_rebuff_deedsonly_rogue.zh: 知情人？他们是犯错的部下。别给这件事再添一份指控。

gwp_rebuff_deedsonly_trade.en: Their punishment is mine to decide. I offered you two fifths, no more.
gwp_rebuff_deedsonly_trade.zh: 我知道钱不够你报的数。我只认我答应的四成。

gwp_rebuff_haggledown_lead.en: You call it an exact account; I call it too much. My offer is still seven tenths.
gwp_rebuff_haggledown_lead.zh: 你说没有打折的命令，我也没答应任你开价。

gwp_rebuff_haggledown_charm.en: You call it an exact account; I call it too much. My offer is still seven tenths.
gwp_rebuff_haggledown_charm.zh: 想少一次争执，你同样可以接受我给的七成。

gwp_rebuff_haggledown_rogue.en: You call it an exact account; I call it too much. My offer is still seven tenths.
gwp_rebuff_haggledown_rogue.zh: 我知道你能动手。不必每次还价都拿这句话压我。

gwp_rebuff_haggledown_trade.en: You call it an exact account; I call it too much. My offer is still seven tenths.
gwp_rebuff_haggledown_trade.zh: 三成有多少，我算得明白。我争的就是这三成。

gwp_voice_open_upright_0.en: Show me the warrant. I will answer a proper charge.
gwp_voice_open_upright_0.zh: 把委托给我看看。该答的话，我会答。

gwp_voice_open_upright_1.en: If you speak for the Wardens, state your business clearly.
gwp_voice_open_upright_1.zh: 你既然代表灰袍，就把事情说清楚。

gwp_voice_open_cold_0.en: You did not chase me down to ask directions. Speak.
gwp_voice_open_cold_0.zh: 你专程追上来，总不会只是问路。说吧。

gwp_voice_open_cold_1.en: The Wardens want me? Tell me the business first.
gwp_voice_open_cold_1.zh: 灰袍找我？先说是什么事，再谈别的。

gwp_voice_open_fierce_0.en: You had better have a reason for blocking my road.
gwp_voice_open_fierce_0.zh: 拦我的路，总得有个说法吧。

gwp_voice_open_fierce_1.en: I can see your banner. What do you want?
gwp_voice_open_fierce_1.zh: 旗子我看见了。你找我做什么？

gwp_voice_open_soft_0.en: Speak here. There is no need to alarm the others.
gwp_voice_open_soft_0.zh: 有什么事在这里说，别惊动后面的人。

gwp_voice_open_soft_1.en: The Wardens... Who has suffered this time?
gwp_voice_open_soft_1.zh: 灰袍来了……又有谁受了苦？

gwp_voice_open_tight_0.en: Say your piece. I have promised you nothing.
gwp_voice_open_tight_0.zh: 先说清楚，我可没答应给你什么。

gwp_voice_open_tight_1.en: A visit from your people is seldom cheap.
gwp_voice_open_tight_1.zh: 你们找上门来，准没什么便宜事。

gwp_voice_open_plain_0.en: You work for the Wardens? What is this about?
gwp_voice_open_plain_0.zh: 你是替灰袍办事的？找我有什么事？

gwp_voice_open_plain_1.en: Wait. Did you say the Wardens sent you?
gwp_voice_open_plain_1.zh: 等一下。你刚才说，灰袍派你来的？

gwp_voice_paid_0.en: We counted the money together. Why are you back?
gwp_voice_paid_0.zh: 钱已经当面点过了。你回来还有什么事？

gwp_voice_paid_1.en: I have paid you. What remains to discuss?
gwp_voice_paid_1.zh: 我已经把钱交给你了，还有哪里没说清？

gwp_voice_fight_upright_0.en: Let everyone here see who draws first.
gwp_voice_fight_upright_0.zh: 那就让在场的人看清楚，是谁先拔的剑。

gwp_voice_fight_upright_1.en: I will not submit. Come and take me.
gwp_voice_fight_upright_1.zh: 我不会束手就擒。你要拿人，尽管来。

gwp_voice_fight_cold_0.en: There is nothing left to reckon. Form up.
gwp_voice_fight_cold_0.zh: 话说到这里，也没什么可算的了。列阵。

gwp_voice_fight_cold_1.en: You chose this course. I hope you counted the cost.
gwp_voice_fight_cold_1.zh: 你选了这条路。希望你算过代价。

gwp_voice_fight_fierce_0.en: Good! We could have spared ourselves the speeches.
gwp_voice_fight_fierce_0.zh: 好！刚才那些话早该省了。

gwp_voice_fight_fierce_1.en: Come, then. Let us see if you can!
gwp_voice_fight_fierce_1.zh: 来啊，看你有没有这个本事！

gwp_voice_fight_soft_0.en: Must this end in blood? Then I have to defend my people.
gwp_voice_fight_soft_0.zh: 一定要流血才肯罢休吗？那我也只能迎战。

gwp_voice_fight_soft_1.en: Stand back, away from us. It seems there is no avoiding this.
gwp_voice_fight_soft_1.zh: 退后，别站在我们中间。看来今天是躲不过了。

gwp_voice_fight_tight_0.en: Cannot take the money, so you take me? Try it.
gwp_voice_fight_tight_0.zh: 钱拿不走，就来抢人？你试试看。

gwp_voice_fight_tight_1.en: You want to hand me over? It will not be easy.
gwp_voice_fight_tight_1.zh: 想拿我去交差？没那么容易。

gwp_voice_fight_plain_0.en: Then there is nothing left to say. Draw.
gwp_voice_fight_plain_0.zh: 那就没什么好说的了。拔剑吧。

gwp_voice_fight_plain_1.en: I will not hold out my hands for your ropes.
gwp_voice_fight_plain_1.zh: 我可不会自己伸手让你绑。

gwp_voice_betray_upright_0.en: You took the money and now break our agreement? Everyone heard it!
gwp_voice_betray_upright_0.zh: 钱你收了，约定却不认了？在场的人都听见了！

gwp_voice_betray_upright_1.en: I paid as agreed. Is this how you serve the Wardens?
gwp_voice_betray_upright_1.zh: 我照约定付了钱。你就是这样替灰袍办事的？

gwp_voice_betray_cold_0.en: So payment was not the end. I gave your word too much credit.
gwp_voice_betray_cold_0.zh: 原来收钱还不算完。是我把你的话看得太重了。

gwp_voice_betray_cold_1.en: My money in your purse and me in your prison cart? Quite a bargain.
gwp_voice_betray_cold_1.zh: 钱进了你的口袋，我还得进你的囚车？好一笔买卖。

gwp_voice_betray_fierce_0.en: You take my money and turn on me? Draw your sword!
gwp_voice_betray_fierce_0.zh: 拿了钱还敢翻脸？把剑拔出来！

gwp_voice_betray_fierce_1.en: I did not pay out of fear! Now you will learn that.
gwp_voice_betray_fierce_1.zh: 我付钱可不是怕你！现在你就会知道。

gwp_voice_betray_soft_0.en: I paid so everyone could leave safely. Will you not even allow that?
gwp_voice_betray_soft_0.zh: 我交钱是为了让大家平安离开。你连这个也不肯？

gwp_voice_betray_soft_1.en: You have the money. Why force these people to fight as well?
gwp_voice_betray_soft_1.zh: 钱已经给了，为什么还要逼这些人拼命？

gwp_voice_betray_tight_0.en: Give that money back! Paid and arrested, is that your trade?
gwp_voice_betray_tight_0.zh: 把刚才的钱还来！收了钱还要抓我，你倒会做生意！

gwp_voice_betray_tight_1.en: I counted every coin into your hands, and now it means nothing?
gwp_voice_betray_tight_1.zh: 我一枚一枚数给你的，现在你说不算？

gwp_voice_betray_plain_0.en: Wait, I already paid you! How can you turn on me now?
gwp_voice_betray_plain_0.zh: 等等，钱不是已经给你了吗？你怎么说翻脸就翻脸？

gwp_voice_betray_plain_1.en: That was not our agreement! You have the money. What more do you want?
gwp_voice_betray_plain_1.zh: 刚才可不是这么说的！钱你也拿了，还要怎样？

gwp_voice_success_upright_0.en: That is a fair point. I accept it.

gwp_voice_success_cold_0.en: That is something I must consider.

gwp_voice_success_soft_0.en: I cannot ignore the people you speak of.
gwp_voice_success_soft_0.zh: 你说的这些人，我不能不管。

gwp_voice_success_soft_1.en: Yes... I should give that more thought.
gwp_voice_success_soft_1.zh: 是……这件事我该多想一想。

gwp_voice_success_tight_0.en: As you put it, there is something in it for me.
gwp_voice_success_tight_0.zh: 照你这么说，我也不是一点好处都没有。

gwp_voice_success_tight_1.en: Those figures do make some sense.

gwp_voice_success_plain_1.en: You have persuaded me on that point.

gwp_voice_demand_payinfull_alt.en: I will pay the assessed sum. Let us settle this.
gwp_voice_demand_payinfull_alt.zh: 照数付清就是了。把这件事了结吧。

gwp_voice_demand_paytoavoidbattle_alt.en: Tell your men to hold. I will pay in full; nobody needs to die here.
gwp_voice_demand_paytoavoidbattle_alt.zh: 先叫你的人别动。钱我照付，犯不着在这里死人。

gwp_voice_demand_payforpeace_alt.en: Enough people have suffered. I will pay in full; leave the others out of it.
gwp_voice_demand_payforpeace_alt.zh: 已经够多人受罪了。我把罚金付清，别再牵连别人。

gwp_voice_demand_paygenerously_alt.en: I can afford it. Take the whole sum and settle the account.
gwp_voice_demand_paygenerously_alt.zh: 这些钱我出得起，全部拿去，把账结清。

gwp_voice_demand_surrenderself_alt.en: The money must feed these men. If you need a prisoner, take me alone.
gwp_voice_demand_surrenderself_alt.zh: 钱得留着养活这些人。你要交差，就带我一个走。

gwp_voice_demand_bribethewarden_alt.en: This is worth {GWP_BRIBE_AMOUNT} denars to you. Take it and let our discussion end here.
gwp_voice_demand_bribethewarden_alt.zh: 这份好处值 {GWP_BRIBE_AMOUNT} 第纳尔，比白跑一趟强。拿了，我们就把话说到这里。

gwp_voice_demand_cunninghalf_alt.en: I cannot raise that sum. Half is all there is. Take it if you want it.
gwp_voice_demand_cunninghalf_alt.zh: 你要的数目我凑不齐。只有一半，你要就拿去。

gwp_voice_demand_rashmost_alt.en: Four fifths. Take it. Spare me the argument over the rest.
gwp_voice_demand_rashmost_alt.zh: 八成，拿去吧。剩下两成就别再费口舌了。

gwp_voice_demand_demandduel_alt.en: Just you and me. You win, I pay the fine. I win, you leave empty-handed.
gwp_voice_demand_demandduel_alt.zh: 我们两个来比一场。你赢，罚金照付；我赢，你空手走。

gwp_voice_demand_deedsonly_alt.en: Two fifths is all I will pay. I will kill the men I blame myself.
gwp_voice_demand_deedsonly_alt.zh: 我只出四成。那几个办坏事的，我自己会杀给你看。

gwp_voice_demand_haggledown_alt.en: Seven tenths is plenty. Think carefully about that offer.
gwp_voice_demand_haggledown_alt.zh: 七成已经够多了。这个价钱，你好好想想。

gwp_voice_hear_alt.en: I heard the charge. Why should I accept your authority?
gwp_voice_hear_alt.zh: 罪名我听见了。可我凭什么听你处置？

gwp_voice_refuse_alt.en: You want me to accept your authority? No. Stand aside.

gwp_voice_done1_alt.en: All right, I accept the charge. We still have to agree on how to settle it.
gwp_voice_done1_alt.zh: 行，这件案子我认。至于怎么了结，我们还得谈。

gwp_voice_lost1_alt.en: You still have not given me a reason to submit. Stop circling the matter.
gwp_voice_lost1_alt.zh: 你还没说出让我服气的理由。别再绕了。

gwp_voice_done2_alt.en: All right, the sum you named. No further conditions.
gwp_voice_done2_alt.zh: 好，按你说的数目来。别再加别的条件了。

gwp_voice_lost2_alt.en: I will not yield on that. My offer still stands.
gwp_voice_lost2_alt.zh: 这一步我不让。刚才开的条件仍然算数。

gwp_case_capture_missed.en: The target was not taken. The commission is not yet done.
gwp_case_capture_missed.zh: 目标未被俘获，委托尚未完成。

gwp_fa_task_authority_variant_1.en: The Wardens may have a say, but that does not put you in command of me.
gwp_fa_task_authority_variant_1.zh: 灰袍管得着这件事，也不见得轮得到你来管我。

gwp_fa_task_authority_variant_2.en: You are running an errand for the Wardens. Why should I answer to you?
gwp_fa_task_authority_variant_2.zh: 你不过是替灰袍跑腿的。我凭什么听你的？

gwp_fa_task_under_charge_variant_1.en: Your own reputation is hardly spotless. Now you lecture me?
gwp_fa_task_under_charge_variant_1.zh: 你自己也没什么好名声，倒来教训我了？

gwp_fa_task_under_charge_variant_2.en: I might listen to someone else. You should put your own affairs right first.
gwp_fa_task_under_charge_variant_2.zh: 换个人来，我兴许还愿意听。你？先管好自己吧。

gwp_fa_task_price_variant_1.en: That much? What gives the Wardens cause to demand that sum?
gwp_fa_task_price_variant_1.zh: 这么多钱？灰袍凭什么向我要这个数？

gwp_fa_task_price_variant_2.en: You ask for a great deal of money. You owe me an explanation.
gwp_fa_task_price_variant_2.zh: 你开口就是这么大一笔，总得给我个说法吧。

gwp_fa_task_tally_variant_1.en: You mean to pursue the older offences too? How far back will you go?
gwp_fa_task_tally_variant_1.zh: 过去的事也要一起追究？你们到底想追到什么时候？

gwp_fa_task_tally_variant_2.en: Those incidents were long apart. Now you bring them all to me at once?
gwp_fa_task_tally_variant_2.zh: 那些事都隔了多久了，现在倒一起来找我？

gwp_fa_task_denial_variant_1.en: Ask my soldiers what they did. I gave no such order.
gwp_fa_task_denial_variant_1.zh: 我的兵做了什么，你找他们去。我没叫他们这么干。

gwp_fa_task_denial_variant_2.en: Why should I bear all the blame for what my men did?
gwp_fa_task_denial_variant_2.zh: 部下惹的事，凭什么全要我来担？

gwp_fa_task_war_variant_1.en: We cannot take enemy goods in war now? The Wardens reach too far.
gwp_fa_task_war_variant_1.zh: 打仗还不能拿敌人的东西？灰袍未免管得太宽了。

gwp_fa_task_war_variant_2.en: That was an enemy caravan. I am fighting a war, not robbing travellers.
gwp_fa_task_war_variant_2.zh: 那是敌人的商队。我在打仗，不是在拦路抢劫。

gwp_fa_task_consequence_variant_1.en: Suppose I refuse to pay today. What will you do?
gwp_fa_task_consequence_variant_1.zh: 我今天就是不交，你打算怎么办？

gwp_fa_task_consequence_variant_2.en: I will take my men and ride on. Will the Wardens follow me forever?
gwp_fa_task_consequence_variant_2.zh: 我带着人走我的路。灰袍还能一直追着我不成？

gwp_fa_task_record_variant_1.en: The Wardens already took me once. Was that not enough?
gwp_fa_task_record_variant_1.zh: 灰袍以前已经抓过我一次了，还不够吗？

gwp_fa_task_record_variant_2.en: The Wardens again. Must your people follow wherever I go?
gwp_fa_task_record_variant_2.zh: 又是灰袍。难道我往后走到哪里，你们都要跟着？

gwp_terms_final_objection_variant_1.en: What do I gain by giving up all my terms?
gwp_terms_final_objection_variant_1.zh: 我把条件全让了，对我又有什么好处？

gwp_terms_final_objection_variant_2.en: Why should I accept the loss and pay everything you ask?
gwp_terms_final_objection_variant_2.zh: 照你说的全部交清，我为什么要吃这个亏？

gwp_fa_open_under_charge_variant_1.en: You work for the Wardens now? That is new. What do you want?
gwp_fa_open_under_charge_variant_1.zh: 你也替灰袍办事了？这倒新鲜。找我什么事？

gwp_fa_open_under_charge_variant_2.en: I have heard of you. Tell me what the Wardens sent you for.
gwp_fa_open_under_charge_variant_2.zh: 听过你的名声。先说吧，灰袍让你来干什么？

gwp_fa_open_respected_known_variant_1.en: You. My last meeting with the Wardens was no pleasure. What is it now?
gwp_fa_open_respected_known_variant_1.zh: 是你。上次见到灰袍可不是什么好事，这回又怎么了？

gwp_fa_open_respected_known_variant_2.en: The Wardens want me again? Speak. I am listening.
gwp_fa_open_respected_known_variant_2.zh: 灰袍又找上我了？说吧，我听着。

gwp_fa_open_respected_variant_1.en: I have heard of you. State your business.
gwp_fa_open_respected_variant_1.zh: 你的名声我听过。有什么事，直说吧。

gwp_fa_open_respected_variant_2.en: If the Wardens sent you, there must be business to discuss. Go on.
gwp_fa_open_respected_variant_2.zh: 灰袍派你来，看来是有事要谈。说吧。

gwp_fa_open_known_variant_1.en: I have not forgotten being taken by your people. What do you want this time?
gwp_fa_open_known_variant_1.zh: 上次被你们带走的滋味，我可没忘。这回要做什么？

gwp_fa_open_known_variant_2.en: Stopping me again? What do the Wardens want now?
gwp_fa_open_known_variant_2.zh: 又拦我？灰袍这次有什么事？

gwp_fa_desire_grace.en: Give me three days to raise the money. Come back then and I will answer for the payment.
gwp_fa_desire_grace.zh: 给我三天筹钱。到时候你再来，这笔罚金我会给你个交代。

gwp_fa_accept_grace.en: Three days, once only. I will return for payment.
gwp_fa_accept_grace.zh: 三天，只宽限这一次。我会回来收钱。

gwp_voice_grace_alt.en: I need three days to gather the money. I am asking for time, not forgiveness.
gwp_voice_grace_alt.zh: 我需要三天把钱凑起来。我求的是宽限，不是免掉罚金。

gwp_grace_granted.en: You allowed {VAR_1} three days to raise the fine. The commission remains open; return to collect it or take the offender into custody.
gwp_grace_granted.zh: 你给了{VAR_1}三天筹措罚金。委托尚未完成，届时仍须收钱或拿人。

gwp_grace_due.en: The time you allowed {VAR_1} has expired. Seek payment or take him into custody; no payment has been received automatically.
gwp_grace_due.zh: 你给{VAR_1}的宽限已经到期。可以前去收钱或拿人。

gwp_fa_grace_wait.en: Then I will come back on the day we named.
gwp_fa_grace_wait.zh: 那我就等到说好的那天再来。

gwp_grace_return_early.en: You gave me until the day we named. It has not come yet. I have nothing ready for you before then.
gwp_grace_return_early.zh: 说好的日子还没到。到那天之前，我这儿拿不出什么给你。

gwp_grace_return_due.en: The time we agreed is up. Let us see what I can pay now.
gwp_grace_return_due.zh: 说好的日子到了。你看看我现在能拿出多少吧。

gwp_grace_collect.en: Show me what you can pay now.
gwp_grace_collect.zh: 把现在能交的钱拿出来看看。

gwp_terms_requestgrace_lead.en: The Wardens expect payment, not another delay. Show me what you have now.
gwp_terms_requestgrace_lead.zh: 灰袍等的是罚金，不是再拖几天。先把你眼下能交的拿出来。

gwp_terms_requestgrace_charm.en: Let us settle what you can today. There is no need to leave this hanging over your people.
gwp_terms_requestgrace_charm.zh: 今天能交多少就先解决多少，别让这件事一直压着你和部下。

gwp_terms_requestgrace_rogue.en: Three days to disappear? I would rather see the money you carry now.
gwp_terms_requestgrace_rogue.zh: 三天，够你走出多远？我更想先看看你现在的钱袋。

gwp_terms_requestgrace_trade.en: Waiting costs both our parties. Pay what you can now and save another journey.
gwp_terms_requestgrace_trade.zh: 你我再跑一趟都要花钱。今天把能付的付了，少耽误些工夫。

gwp_rebuff_requestgrace_lead.en: I asked for time to raise it. Repeating the amount will not fill my purse today.
gwp_rebuff_requestgrace_lead.zh: 我没说不交。我说的是筹钱需要时间。

gwp_rebuff_requestgrace_charm.en: I asked for time to raise it. Repeating the amount will not fill my purse today.
gwp_rebuff_requestgrace_charm.zh: 我也想今天就了结，可你总得容我把钱凑来。

gwp_rebuff_requestgrace_rogue.en: I asked for time to raise it. Repeating the amount will not fill my purse today.
gwp_rebuff_requestgrace_rogue.zh: 你不信我，我也没办法。但催得再紧，钱也不会自己出现。

gwp_rebuff_requestgrace_trade.en: I asked for time to raise it. Repeating the amount will not fill my purse today.
gwp_rebuff_requestgrace_trade.zh: 再跑一趟是麻烦，可现在让我凑齐，同样办不到。

gwp_duel_payment_pending.en: You win the duel. You may now collect his fine.
gwp_duel_payment_pending.zh: 你赢了决斗，可以收缴他的罚金。

gwp_duel_inspect_property.en: Show me your property. We will settle the fine now.
gwp_duel_inspect_property.zh: 把你的财物拿出来，现在结清罚金。

gwp_duel_return_collect.en: You won our duel. I still owe you the payment we agreed.
gwp_duel_return_collect.zh: 单挑是你赢了。照约定，我还欠着你这笔罚金。

gwp_case_pay_any.en: I am ready to submit my report. Let us settle the account.

gwp_case_resume_report.en: About the shortfall in what I handed over...
gwp_case_resume_report.zh: 刚才交的钱物还差一些，我来说明原因。

gwp_case_nothing_concealed.en: That is what he put in your hands, and all of it is here. Your report will be entered.
gwp_case_nothing_concealed.zh: 他交到你手上的就是这些，一分不少地都在这儿了。你的汇报会照实登记。

gwp_case_report_kept_result.en: The {VAR_1} denars are entered. Your expenses are {VAR_2} denars. The commission is concluded.
gwp_case_report_kept_result.zh: 这 {VAR_1} 第纳尔已经登记。你的办案费是 {VAR_2} 第纳尔。委托就此结清。

gwp_voice_submit_upright_0.en: The charge is fair. Take it, and let it be written that I paid it standing.
gwp_voice_submit_upright_0.zh: 这笔罚是公道的。拿去吧，记上一笔：我是站着交的。

gwp_voice_submit_upright_1.en: I will not argue a debt I owe. Count it.

gwp_voice_submit_upright_2.en: Then it is owed, and I pay what is owed. Here.
gwp_voice_submit_upright_2.zh: 那就是欠着的，欠着的我就还。给。

gwp_voice_submit_cold_0.en: Cheaper than the alternative. That is the only reason, and we both know it.
gwp_voice_submit_cold_0.zh: 比另一条路便宜。就这一个理由，你我都清楚。

gwp_voice_submit_cold_1.en: The sum is smaller than the trouble. Take it.

gwp_voice_submit_cold_2.en: I have weighed it. You win this column. Count your money.
gwp_voice_submit_cold_2.zh: 我算过了。这一栏是你赢。点你的钱去。

gwp_voice_submit_soft_0.en: Take it. It buys nothing back, but take it.
gwp_voice_submit_soft_0.zh: 拿去吧。什么也换不回来，但还是拿去吧。

gwp_voice_submit_soft_1.en: If this closes the matter for them, then take it.
gwp_voice_submit_soft_1.zh: 要是这样能给他们一个了断，那就拿去。

gwp_voice_submit_soft_2.en: Here. I would rather it went to them than stayed with me.
gwp_voice_submit_soft_2.zh: 给。与其留在我手里，不如给他们。

gwp_voice_submit_tight_0.en: Every coin of it. I hope your order chokes on the counting.
gwp_voice_submit_tight_0.zh: 一个子儿不少。但愿你们那个修会点钱噎着。

gwp_voice_submit_tight_1.en: There. Count it twice, you will not find a coin short.
gwp_voice_submit_tight_1.zh: 在这儿。点两遍，也不会少一个子儿。

gwp_voice_submit_tight_2.en: Take it and be quick. Every moment of this costs me more.
gwp_voice_submit_tight_2.zh: 拿了就快走。这事多拖一刻我就多亏一刻。

gwp_voice_submit_fierce_0.en: Fine. Money, then. Do not mistake it for fear.
gwp_voice_submit_fierce_0.zh: 行，给钱。别当成我怕了你。

gwp_voice_submit_fierce_1.en: Take your coin. It settles nothing between us.
gwp_voice_submit_fierce_1.zh: 拿你的钱。你我之间什么也没了结。

gwp_voice_submit_fierce_2.en: Here, and let that be the end of your talking.

gwp_voice_submit_plain_0.en: Here. Count it, and be gone.

gwp_voice_submit_plain_1.en: All right. The sum you named, no more.
gwp_voice_submit_plain_1.zh: 好吧。你报的那个数，一分不多。

gwp_voice_submit_plain_2.en: Take it. I want no further trouble over this.
gwp_voice_submit_plain_2.zh: 拿去。这事我不想再有麻烦。

gwp_voice_plead_cold_0.en: You have named a sum I cannot meet. Wages, feed, remounts - look at the column and tell me where it hides.
gwp_voice_plead_cold_0.zh: 你开的这个数我拿不出来。军饷、草料、换马——你指给我看它藏在哪一栏。

gwp_voice_plead_cold_1.en: The figure is beyond me. I can show you the accounts if you doubt it.
gwp_voice_plead_cold_1.zh: 这个数超出我的能耐。你要是不信，账本可以给你看。

gwp_voice_plead_cold_2.en: What you ask does not exist in my purse. That is simply the arithmetic.
gwp_voice_plead_cold_2.zh: 你要的东西不在我钱袋里。这就是个算术问题。

gwp_voice_plead_tight_0.en: I am not a rich man, whatever your ledger says. You will not find it on me.
gwp_voice_plead_tight_0.zh: 我不是什么富人，你们卷宗上怎么写是你们的事。这钱你在我身上找不到。

gwp_voice_plead_tight_1.en: Search me if you like. There is nothing like that sum here.
gwp_voice_plead_tight_1.zh: 你愿意搜就搜。这儿没有那么多。

gwp_voice_plead_tight_2.en: You have been told wrong about my means. I cannot pay it.
gwp_voice_plead_tight_2.zh: 有人把我的家底跟你说岔了。我付不出。

gwp_voice_plead_upright_0.en: I will not promise what I cannot pay. That sum is beyond me.
gwp_voice_plead_upright_0.zh: 我不会答应我付不出的东西。这个数我够不着。

gwp_voice_plead_upright_1.en: I would pay it if I had it. I do not.
gwp_voice_plead_upright_1.zh: 有的话我就付了。我没有。

gwp_voice_plead_soft_0.en: I have men to feed before I have coin for you. There is nothing left.
gwp_voice_plead_soft_0.zh: 我得先让手下的人吃上饭，才轮到你的钱。已经没剩下什么了。

gwp_voice_plead_soft_1.en: Do not take what these people still need. I cannot meet it.
gwp_voice_plead_soft_1.zh: 别拿这些人还要用的东西。这个数我凑不出。

gwp_voice_plead_fierce_0.en: I have no such money, and I will not pretend otherwise.
gwp_voice_plead_fierce_0.zh: 我没有这笔钱，也不打算装作有。

gwp_voice_plead_fierce_1.en: Ask for what I have, not for what I do not.
gwp_voice_plead_fierce_1.zh: 按我有的要，别按我没有的要。

gwp_voice_plead_plain_0.en: That sum? I do not carry it. Search the baggage if you like.
gwp_voice_plead_plain_0.zh: 那个数？我身上没带。你想翻辎重就翻。

gwp_voice_plead_plain_1.en: I cannot raise that. Not today, not from what I have here.
gwp_voice_plead_plain_1.zh: 这个数我凑不出来。今天不行，就凭我手上这点更不行。

gwp_voice_resist_upright_0.en: I will not pay for a charge I do not accept. Do what you came to do.
gwp_voice_resist_upright_0.zh: 我不认的罪，我不会掏钱。你们要办就办吧。

gwp_voice_resist_upright_1.en: Bring me before someone with the standing to judge it. Until then, no.
gwp_voice_resist_upright_1.zh: 把我带到有资格裁断这件事的人跟前。在那之前，不行。

gwp_voice_resist_fierce_0.en: I have never bought my way out of anything. Draw.
gwp_voice_resist_fierce_0.zh: 我从来没花钱买过平安。拔刀。

gwp_voice_resist_fierce_1.en: You will take nothing from me while I stand. Come on, then.
gwp_voice_resist_fierce_1.zh: 我站着的时候，你从我身上拿不走任何东西。来吧。

gwp_voice_resist_fierce_2.en: Enough talk. Let the swords settle it.

gwp_voice_resist_cold_0.en: I have counted your column and I have counted mine. No.
gwp_voice_resist_cold_0.zh: 你那一列我数过，我这一列我也数过。不行。

gwp_voice_resist_cold_1.en: The odds do not favour you enough. My answer is no.
gwp_voice_resist_cold_1.zh: 这个胜算还不够你张这个口。我的答复是不。

gwp_voice_resist_cold_2.en: No. You may test that answer if you wish.
gwp_voice_resist_cold_2.zh: 不。你愿意的话，可以试试这个答复。

gwp_voice_resist_tight_0.en: You will not have a denar of it. Not one.
gwp_voice_resist_tight_0.zh: 一个第纳尔你也别想拿到。一个都没有。

gwp_voice_resist_tight_1.en: I would sooner bleed than pay that. Try me.
gwp_voice_resist_tight_1.zh: 要我交那个数，我宁可流血。你试试。

gwp_voice_resist_tight_2.en: Not a coin. Take it off my body if you can.
gwp_voice_resist_tight_2.zh: 一个子儿也没有。有本事从我尸首上摸。

gwp_voice_resist_soft_0.en: I cannot give you what my people still need. I will not.
gwp_voice_resist_soft_0.zh: 我的人还要用的东西，我不能给你。我不给。

gwp_voice_resist_soft_1.en: I am sorry it comes to this, but my answer is no.
gwp_voice_resist_soft_1.zh: 走到这一步我也难过，但我的答复是不。

gwp_voice_resist_plain_0.en: No. Come and take it, if you can.

gwp_voice_resist_plain_1.en: My answer is no. Do as you must.
gwp_voice_resist_plain_1.zh: 我的答复是不。你该怎么办就怎么办。

gwp_voice_resist_scorn_0.en: You are under your own charge and you come to collect mine? Draw.
gwp_voice_resist_scorn_0.zh: 你自己头上还挂着案子，倒来收我的？拔刀吧。

gwp_voice_resist_scorn_1.en: A wanted man collecting fines. I will not answer to you.
gwp_voice_resist_scorn_1.zh: 一个通缉犯跑来收罚金。我不向你交代。

gwp_voice_resist_scorn_2.en: Put your own name right before you read mine off a list.
gwp_voice_resist_scorn_2.zh: 先把你自己的名字弄干净，再照单子念我的。

gwp_case_short_question.en: There are still matters to explain in this case. Tell me what happened.
gwp_case_short_question.zh: 这宗案子还有需要交代的地方。说说经过。

gwp_request_case_support.en: I need your help taking the offender. Take the field with me.
gwp_request_case_support.zh: 我需要你们帮忙拿下那个人。跟我一起上。

gwp_request_case_support_reply.en: Then let us ride. We stay at your shoulder, and we will not be behind you when it starts.
gwp_request_case_support_reply.zh: 那就走吧。我们跟着你，动起手来不会落在你后面。

gwp_support_requested_log.en: You have asked the Wardens to ride with you.

gwp_offer_changed.en: What you hand over does not match the agreement. Adjust it and try again.
gwp_offer_changed.zh: 交付的钱物与约定不符，请重新调整。

gwp_case_defeat_recorded.en: You broke {VAR_1} in the field. Go and make your report.
gwp_case_defeat_recorded.zh: 你在野外击溃了{VAR_1}。回去复命吧。

gwp_case_truthful_defeat_result.zh: 你在野外把他打垮了。实收的 {VAR_1} 第纳尔已经入账，余款记在他名下。花销 {VAR_2} 第纳尔，委托结清。

gwp_bounty_contract_expired_but_done.en: The time for the hunt has passed, but the target has been dealt with. Report to any Warden lord.
gwp_bounty_contract_expired_but_done.zh: 追捕期限已过，但目标已受惩处。向任意一位灰袍领主复命即可。

gwp_report_excess_found.en: {VAR_1} had already answered for his crimes, yet you struck him down. The Wardens have taken note.
gwp_report_excess_found.zh: 灰袍查明{VAR_1}已受过惩处，你仍对他动了手。

gwp_support_granted_notice.en: {VAR_1} has agreed and is on her way to join you.

gwp_support_player_war.en: The Wardens declare war on {VAR_1}, and you stand with them.
gwp_support_player_war.zh: 灰袍向{VAR_1}宣战，你随之参战。

gwp_dispatch_talk_hint.en: Send these men on an errand

gwp_dispatch_greeting.en: Commander. Say the word and we ride.
gwp_dispatch_greeting.zh: 指挥官。您吩咐，我们就走。

gwp_dispatch_report.en: Take our account of the commission to the Wardens for me.
gwp_dispatch_report.zh: 替我把这桩委托的账送到灰袍那里。

gwp_dispatch_support.en: Ride to the Wardens and ask them to take the field with me.
gwp_dispatch_support.zh: 去灰袍那里，请他们与我一同出阵。

gwp_dispatch_never_mind.en: Nothing for now. Back to your post.

gwp_dispatch_confirm.en: Then pick the men who ride with me, Commander.
gwp_dispatch_confirm.zh: 那就请指挥官点出随我上路的人。

gwp_dispatch_no_receiver.en: There is no Warden company within reach to receive them.
gwp_dispatch_no_receiver.zh: 附近没有可以接收的灰袍队伍。

gwp_dispatch_no_spare_ship.en: You are at sea with no ship to spare. They can set out once you reach land.
gwp_dispatch_no_spare_ship.zh: 你在海上，没有多余的船，靠岸后才能派出。

gwp_dispatch_no_rations.zh: 你既拿不出干粮，也拿不出买粮的钱。先备点东西，再派人出门。

gwp_dispatch_sent.en: The company you sent has set out for {VAR_1}.
gwp_dispatch_sent.zh: 你派出的队伍已出发前往{VAR_1}处。

gwp_dispatch_lost.en: The company you sent out was destroyed, and everything it carried is lost.
gwp_dispatch_lost.zh: 你派出的队伍全军覆没，所带财物尽失。

gwp_dispatch_returning.en: The company you sent has done its work and is returning.
gwp_dispatch_returning.zh: 你派出的队伍已办完差事，正在返回。

gwp_dispatch_prisoners_sold.en: Your men sold {VAR_1} prisoners in {VAR_2} for {VAR_3} denars.
gwp_dispatch_prisoners_sold.zh: 你的队伍在{VAR_2}卖出 {VAR_1} 名俘虏，得 {VAR_3} 第纳尔。

gwp_dispatch_support_moot.en: The message was delivered, but help is no longer needed.
gwp_dispatch_support_moot.zh: 信已送到，但此事已无需援手。

gwp_dispatch_handover.en: Your detachment has rejoined you: {VAR_1} men ({VAR_2} wounded), {VAR_3} prisoners, {VAR_4} items and {VAR_5} denars returned to your party.
gwp_dispatch_handover.zh: 派出的队伍已经归队：交回 {VAR_1} 人（其中 {VAR_2} 名伤员）、{VAR_3} 名俘虏、{VAR_4} 件物资和 {VAR_5} 第纳尔。

gwp_dispatch_report_done.en: The commission is settled. Your men are returning with {VAR_1} denars.
gwp_dispatch_report_done.zh: 委托已结清，你的队伍正带着 {VAR_1} 第纳尔赏金返回。

gwp_dispatch_prisoner_failed.en: The handover failed. The prisoner is still in your hands.
gwp_dispatch_prisoner_failed.zh: 押送未能交接，俘虏仍在你手中。

gwp_dispatch_word_title.en: What your men are to say

gwp_dispatch_word_body.en: They will hand over {VAR_1} of the {VAR_2} on the account. What account do they give of the rest?
gwp_dispatch_word_body.zh: 案子应缴 {VAR_2}，这次钱货合计 {VAR_1}。办案经过，让他们怎么交代？

gwp_dispatch_report_moot.en: The commission is already settled. What your men carried is coming back to you.
gwp_dispatch_report_moot.zh: 委托已经结清，所带财物将原样带回。

gwp_bounty_case_is_yours.en: The bounty is yours. If you need help, send word to the Wardens.
gwp_bounty_case_is_yours.zh: 你接下了这桩悬赏。需要援手时可派人向灰袍求援。

gwp_support_no_responder.en: No Warden lord can come just now.
gwp_support_no_responder.zh: 眼下没有灰袍领主能够前来。

gwp_bounty_intel_lost.en: [Investigation] The scouts have lost the trail. There is no sighting to report this time.
gwp_bounty_intel_lost.zh: 【侦情】探子跟丢了，这一次没有目击可报。

gwp_case_withdrawn_result.en: The man was already beyond reach. The treasury covers {VAR_1} denars for your trouble. The commission is closed.
gwp_case_withdrawn_result.zh: 那个人早就够不着了。公库付你 {VAR_1} 第纳尔，算这趟的花销。委托结清。

gwp_case_report_withdrawn_summary.en: We have word that the man is beyond reach. Say the word and I will settle your expenses.
gwp_case_report_withdrawn_summary.zh: 我们这边已经得到消息，那个人够不着了。你说一声，我把你的花销结了。

gwp_case_owner_player.en: Tracking: {VAR_1} | Stage: commissioned to the player
gwp_case_owner_player.zh: 追踪情况：{VAR_1} | 当前阶段：已交由玩家承办

gwp_case_owner_player_supported.zh: 追踪情况：{VAR_1} | 支援：{VAR_2} | 当前阶段：{VAR_3}

gwp_dispatch_trouble_battle.en: Word reaches you: the men you sent have been brought to battle.
gwp_dispatch_trouble_battle.zh: 有消息传来：你派出去的人被堵上了，正在交战。

gwp_dispatch_trouble_mauled.en: Word reaches you: the men you sent have been badly cut up.
gwp_dispatch_trouble_mauled.zh: 有消息传来：你派出去的人伤亡过半。

gwp_dispatch_trouble_starving.zh: 有消息传来：你派出去的人已经断粮。

gwp_case_settle_expenses.en: The commission is closed. We will settle what you are owed.
gwp_case_settle_expenses.zh: 这桩委托已经了结，把该付你的报酬结清就行。

gwp_troop_zealot.context: 兵种树、名册、战场兵种名；现有二阶步兵。

gwp_fs_priest_name.context: 村中教士姓名、名牌与百科链接。

gwp_fs_priest_arrived.context: 新教士在村中落脚时的左下角灰色提示。

gwp_fs_ritual_congregation_title.context: 布道进行时进村，仪式菜单标题。

gwp_fs_ritual_damnation_title.context: 火刑期间进村，仪式菜单标题。

gwp_fs_ritual_congregation_text.en: The villagers of {VILLAGE} have gathered to hear the commandments, and new believers are taking their vows. Village business is suspended until the congregation ends, in about {HOURS} hours. Host: {HOST}.
gwp_fs_ritual_congregation_text.zh: {VILLAGE}的村民聚在广场上听讲戒律，新入教的人正在宣誓。集会尚未结束，暂时无法办理村中事务。还需约{HOURS}小时。主持：{HOST}。
gwp_fs_ritual_congregation_text.context: 布道期间的锁村画面；HOST无教士时会回退成村名，故使用中性的“主持方”。

gwp_fs_ritual_damnation_text.en: People are bound to stakes in the square of {VILLAGE}, where a burning is under way. The gathered believers pray as smoke drifts over the roofs. Village business is suspended for about {HOURS} more hours. Host: {HOST}.
gwp_fs_ritual_damnation_text.zh: {VILLAGE}的广场上正在执行火刑。人被绑在木架上，围观的教众齐声祷告，浓烟飘过屋顶。村中事务暂时停办，还需约{HOURS}小时。主持：{HOST}。
gwp_fs_ritual_damnation_text.context: 火刑期间的锁村画面；不把火写成能裁定罪名的神，也不把实际被烧者一律称为罪犯。

gwp_fs_village_option.context: 有灰袍教众记录时的村庄菜单入口。

gwp_fs_village_info.en: Of the {HEARTH} households in {VILLAGE}, {HOUSEHOLDS} follow the Grey Wardens' rule, and {GUARD} believers defend the village. They worship Heaven, hear the priest's teachings, and provide recruits for the Wardens.
gwp_fs_village_info.zh: {VILLAGE}共有{HEARTH}户，其中{HOUSEHOLDS}户奉行灰袍的戒律，{GUARD}名教众负责守村。他们信奉上天，听从教士的教诲，也为灰袍提供兵员。
gwp_fs_village_info.context: 点击村庄教众入口后的详情正文。

gwp_fs_village_priest.en: {PRIEST} preaches here and tends to the faithful. When the Wardens recruit, he introduces villagers willing to serve.
gwp_fs_village_priest.zh: {PRIEST}在此传教，并照管教众。灰袍来征募时，村中愿意从军的人由他引荐。
gwp_fs_village_priest.context: 教众详情中存在在世教士的分支。

gwp_fs_village_no_priest.en: There is currently no Grey Warden priest in the village.
gwp_fs_village_no_priest.zh: 村中暂时没有灰袍教士。
gwp_fs_village_no_priest.context: 教众详情中没有在世教士的分支。

gwp_fs_village_info_title.context: 村庄教众详情弹窗标题。

gwp_fs_village_info_ok.context: 村庄教众详情弹窗关闭按钮。

gwp_fs_ritual_leave.context: 仪式锁村画面的离开按钮。

gwp_fs_militia_change.en: The Grey Warden faithful remain on watch
gwp_fs_militia_change.context: 民兵每日变化的说明条目：抵消灰袍守村兵对应的原版退役项。

gwp_fs_militia_stopped.en: The Grey Warden faithful guard the village; no new militia is raised
gwp_fs_militia_stopped.zh: 灰袍教众负责守卫，停止征募新民兵
gwp_fs_militia_stopped.context: 教士势力已达本村最强时，民兵变化的说明条目。

gwp_fs_priest_lore.en: {PRIEST} teaches the Grey Wardens' rule in {VILLAGE}. He urges villagers to revere Heaven, aid the poor, and submit to the order's discipline. The Wardens' women command its troops and patrols; he gathers the faithful, conducts worship, and helps provide for those who defend the village or join the ranks.
gwp_fs_priest_lore.zh: {PRIEST}在{VILLAGE}传授灰袍的戒律。他教导村民敬畏上天，接济穷人，并服从修会的惩戒。灰袍的女统领掌管武装和巡察，他则召集教众、主持礼拜，为守村与从军的人备办衣食。
gwp_fs_priest_lore.context: 村中灰袍教士的百科介绍；宗教与分工说明。

gwp_fs_village_stores.en: The cellar holds {PRISONERS} people awaiting the stake. The stores contain {ARMORY} pieces of arms and armour, with goods worth {GOODS} denars awaiting transport to market.
gwp_fs_village_stores.zh: 地窖关押着{PRISONERS}人，等候火刑。库房存有{ARMORY}件兵器甲胄，另有价值{GOODS}第纳尔的货物待运往集市。
gwp_fs_village_stores.context: 村庄教众详情最后一段，显示地牢、军械与货物。

gwp_fs_armory_option.context: 仅开发版：有守村队的村庄菜单库房入口。

gwp_fs_armory_close.context: 仅开发版：库房明细关闭按钮。

gwp_fs_armory_section_arms.context: 仅开发版：库房明细中的军械分组。

gwp_fs_armory_section_goods.context: 仅开发版：村庄库房明细中的货仓分组。

gwp_fs_armory_section_inventory.context: 仅开发版：领主库房明细中的背包分组。

gwp_fs_armory_section.context: 仅开发版：库房每个分组的数量与估值标题。

gwp_fs_lord_armory_ask.en: Let me see your company's stores.
gwp_fs_lord_armory_ask.zh: 让我看看你们的随队物资。
gwp_fs_lord_armory_ask.context: 仅开发版：与带队灰袍领主正常交谈时查看物资的玩家选项。

gwp_fs_lord_armory_reply.context: 仅开发版：领主回复后打开库房明细。

gwp_fs_armory_item.context: 仅开发版：库房物品逐项显示。

gwp_fs_armory_village.context: 仅开发版：村庄库房弹窗标题。

gwp_fs_armory_party.context: 仅开发版：领主部队库房弹窗标题。

gwp_fs_armory_empty.context: 仅开发版：该持有者尚无军械账本时的说明。

gwp_fs_armory_summary.en: These stores supply {MEN} people, of whom {ARMED} have weapons. Another {FREE} pieces are held in reserve, and {SURPLUS} surplus pieces will be sold at market.
gwp_fs_armory_summary.zh: 这里为{MEN}人保管装备，其中{ARMED}人已配有兵器；另存{FREE}件备用装备，{SURPLUS}件余货将运往集市出售。
gwp_fs_armory_summary.context: 仅开发版：库房摘要。MEN为配装记录数，ARMED为其中配有主手兵器的记录数。

gwp_fs_party_pretalk.context: 地图遇到教众队伍，买卖取消后回到主对话。

gwp_fs_party_buy.context: 只有卖货队有货、总价大于零且玩家付得起时显示的购买选项。

gwp_fs_party_offer.en: We have {PRODUCTS}, for {TOTAL_PRICE}{GOLD_ICON} in all. The money will go home to support the faithful.
gwp_fs_party_offer.zh: 有{PRODUCTS}，共计{TOTAL_PRICE}{GOLD_ICON}。这些钱要带回去供养教众。
gwp_fs_party_offer.context: 卖货队报价，不把钱说成归某团火所有。

gwp_fs_party_buy_yes.context: 玩家确认买下整批货物。

gwp_fs_party_threaten.context: 玩家威胁任意教众队伍。

gwp_fs_party_refuse.en: We will not hand it over. Draw your sword if you mean to take it.
gwp_fs_party_refuse.zh: 我们不会交给你。要抢，就拔剑。
gwp_fs_party_refuse.context: 教众拒绝玩家威胁；没有交钱或投降分支。

gwp_fs_party_fight.en: Then we have nothing more to discuss.
gwp_fs_party_fight.context: 威胁被拒后，玩家结束对话回到遭遇菜单；此项本身不直接发起战斗。

gwp_fs_party_back_off.context: 玩家收回威胁并离开遭遇。

gwp_fs_party_leave.context: 正常结束教众队伍对话并离开遭遇。

gwp_fs_party_greet_cart_out.en: We come from {HOME}, taking these goods to sell in {TARGET}. The proceeds will support the faithful back home.
gwp_fs_party_greet_cart_out.zh: 我们从{HOME}来，要把这车货送到{TARGET}去卖，所得用来供养村里的教众。
gwp_fs_party_greet_cart_out.context: 地图遇到向集市出发的卖货队。

gwp_fs_party_greet_mission.en: We come from {HOME}, bound for {TARGET} to preach and settle there.
gwp_fs_party_greet_mission.zh: 我们从{HOME}来，要到{TARGET}传教，此后就在那里住下。
gwp_fs_party_greet_mission.context: 地图遇到前往新村的传教队。

gwp_fs_party_greet_balance.en: We come from {HOME}, carrying arms for the faithful of {TARGET}. Once they are delivered, we will stay to help guard the village.
gwp_fs_party_greet_balance.zh: 我们从{HOME}来，为{TARGET}的教众运送兵器。送到以后，我们也留在那里守村。
gwp_fs_party_greet_balance.context: 地图遇到运械队；抵达后人也留下。

gwp_fs_status_balance.en: Carrying arms from {HOME} to the faithful of {TARGET}.
gwp_fs_status_balance.zh: 正从{HOME}运送兵器给{TARGET}的教众。
gwp_fs_status_balance.context: 运械队出发阶段的部队行为说明。

gwp_notice_prisoners.context: 领主向村庄地牢交人后，村庄名牌上的短通知。

gwp_notice_donated.context: 领主交物资后村庄名牌短通知；包含军械与货物，不全是装备。

gwp_notice_congregation.en: {COUNT} households joined the Grey Warden faithful
gwp_notice_congregation.context: 布道完成后的村庄名牌通知；COUNT来自信众新增户数，原中文“人”单位不符。

gwp_notice_damnation.en: {BURNED} were burned at the stake; {SWORN} more households joined the faith
gwp_notice_damnation.context: 火刑处理后的村庄名牌通知；BURNED由人数与户数片段组合。

gwp_notice_burned_people.context: 火刑通知中的俘虏与民兵人数片段。

gwp_notice_burned_homes.context: 火刑通知中的不信教户数片段，不改写成人数。

gwp_notice_mission.context: 传教队抵达后村庄名牌短通知；COUNT是实际留下的兵员人数。

gwp_notice_balance.en: Delivered {COUNT} pieces of arms and armour
gwp_notice_balance.context: 运械队抵达后的村庄名牌通知。

gwp_notice_market.context: 卖货队在城镇卖货后的城镇名牌通知。

gwp_notice_rebuilt.context: 灰袍完成重建后的村庄名牌通知。

gwp_notice_issue_solved.context: 灰袍完成要人事务后的聚落名牌通知。

gwp_fs_status_mission.context: 传教队出发阶段的部队行为说明。

gwp_fs_status_market.en: Taking goods from {HOME} to market in {TARGET}.
gwp_fs_status_market.context: 卖货队出发阶段的部队行为说明。

gwp_fs_status_returning.context: 卖货队返回阶段的部队行为说明。

gwp_fs_status_home.context: 已登记教众队处于本村阶段的部队行为说明。

gwp_fs_status_visit.en: In {VILLAGE}: handed over {PRISONERS} prisoners, donated {DONATED} items, and recruited {RECRUITS} believers.
gwp_fs_status_visit.zh: 在{VILLAGE}交付{PRISONERS}名俘虏、捐赠{DONATED}件物资，招募{RECRUITS}名教众。
gwp_fs_status_visit.context: 灰袍领主在村庄停留且有本次交人、捐物或招兵记录时的行为说明。

gwp_fs_status_healing.context: 灰袍领主在教众村庄停留、无本次交割记录且有伤兵时。

gwp_fs_status_resting.context: 灰袍领主在教众村庄停留、无本次交割记录且没有伤兵时。

gwp_status_petition.en: Settling a petition in {SETTLEMENT} ({HOURS} hours left).
gwp_status_petition.zh: 正在{SETTLEMENT}处理请愿（还剩{HOURS}小时）。

gwp_fs_party_greet_cart_back.en: We have traded at market and are returning to {HOME}.
gwp_fs_party_greet_cart_back.zh: 我们在集市卖过货，正返回{HOME}。
gwp_fs_party_greet_cart_back.context: 地图遇到返村阶段的卖货队；返程可能仍有余货，故不再说全部售完。

gwp_fs_party_products_separator.context: 货物列表与火刑人数/户数组合所用分隔符。

gwp_fs_party_product.context: 卖货队报价中的单个货物条目。

gwp_fs_party_products_more.context: 卖货报价超过四种货物时追加的省略片段。

gwp_fs_healing_hearth.en: Care from the Grey Warden faithful
gwp_fs_healing_hearth.context: 部队治疗速度的解释条目；这是加成来源，不是地图地点。

gwp_envoy_duel_called.en: {VAR_1} has challenged {VAR_2} to settle the Wardens' charge at the tournament in {VAR_3}.
gwp_envoy_duel_called.zh: {VAR_1}向{VAR_2}提出，要在{VAR_3}的比武大会上了结灰袍的指控。

gwp_envoy_duel_warden_won.en: {VAR_1} placed above {VAR_2} at the tournament in {VAR_3}. {VAR_2} pays the Wardens in full.
gwp_envoy_duel_warden_won.zh: {VAR_1}在{VAR_3}的比武大会上名次压过了{VAR_2}。{VAR_2}照数缴清了罚金。

gwp_envoy_duel_offender_won.en: {VAR_1} placed above {VAR_2} at the tournament in {VAR_3}, and the Wardens let him go as agreed.
gwp_envoy_duel_offender_won.zh: {VAR_1}在{VAR_3}的比武大会上名次压过了{VAR_2}，灰袍依约放他离开。

gwp_atonement_closed_elsewhere.en: This case has been settled by someone else. Your atonement assignment is withdrawn, and you will not be penalized.
gwp_atonement_closed_elsewhere.zh: 这宗案子已由他人了结，赎罪委托撤销，不计作你的过失。
gwp_atonement_closed_elsewhere.context: 赎罪目标死亡、被他人俘获或案件在别处结清；撤销任务，不扣声望。

gwp_atonement_report.en: Tell us how the case ended, and hand over anything you collected on our behalf.
gwp_atonement_report.zh: 说说这件事是怎样了结的，代收的钱货也一并交来。
gwp_atonement_report.context: 赎罪交差；有代收钱货或可交俘虏时打开同一套交付界面。

gwp_training_transport_party.context: 练兵官实体运兵队；地图状态和差事台账。

gwp_training_transport_outbound.context: 练兵官实体运兵队；地图状态和差事台账。

gwp_training_transport_greeting.en: We're taking soldiers and arms where the Training Warden has ordered. We must keep moving.
gwp_training_transport_greeting.zh: 我们奉练兵官的命令运送老兵和军械，还得赶路。
gwp_training_transport_greeting.context: 实体运兵队的遭遇对话、落村状态和台账。

gwp_training_transport_settling.context: 实体运兵队的遭遇对话、落村状态和台账。

gwp_training_ledger_settle.en: The transport is taking the remaining soldiers to settle in {VAR_1}.
gwp_training_ledger_settle.zh: 运兵队正带余兵前往{VAR_1}，到村后并入守村队。
gwp_training_ledger_settle.context: 实体运兵队的遭遇对话、落村状态和台账。

gwp_training_stage_settle.context: 实体运兵队的遭遇对话、落村状态和台账。

gwp_notice_training.context: 单程运兵队到村交付后显示的聚落动态。

fragments.terms_default_rogue: Do not leave a debt behind.
fragments.terms_default_lead: Pay the sum on the warrant.
fragments.rebuff_default: That does not change the terms I offered.
